Sub Cari_Ac()

	Dim AKT
	Dim Doc1
	Dim CARI0
	Dim CaRI01
	
	Set AKT=Doc.GetTableObject("AKTVT00")
	Set doc1=Doc.CreateDocumentNOUI("CARI00","")
	Set CARI0=Doc1.GetTableObject("CARI00")
	Set CARI01=Doc.GetTableObject("CARI00")
	
		If Trim(AKT.TURU)="YI" then
			q=Doc.D7MsgBox("Yeni Cari Kart açýlsýn mý?","dinamo ERP",MB_YESNO+MB_ICONQUESTION)
			If q=6 Then	
				Set Cari=doc.Select1("sadfdfs","CARI00","KOD>='120 01'&KOD<'120 02'","<KOD",-1)
				SonCari=Right(Trim(Cari.KOD),4)
				SonCariArt=SonCari+1
				CariKod="120 01"&" "&SonCariArt
				nret=doc1.Load_Voucher(cariKod)
				CARI0.GK_9="1"
				nret=Doc1.Save_Voucher
				If nret=0 Then
					CARI01.KOD=CariKod
					nret=Doc1.Loadempty_voucher()
					Set doc1=nothing
				End If
			End If
		ElseIf Trim(AKT.TURU)="YD" then
			q=Doc.D7MsgBox("Yeni Cari Kart açýlsýn mý?","dinamo ERP",MB_YESNO+MB_ICONQUESTION)
			If q=6 Then	
				Set Cari=doc.Select1("cbgsadfdfs","CARI00","KOD>='120 02'&KOD<'120 03'","<KOD",-1)
				SonCari=Right(Trim(Cari.KOD),4)
				SonCariArt=SonCari+1
				CariKod="120 02"&" "&SonCariArt
				nret=doc1.Load_Voucher(cariKod)
				CARI0.GK_9="1"
				nret=Doc1.Save_Voucher
				If nret=0 Then
					CARI01.KOD=CariKod
					nret=Doc1.Loadempty_voucher()
					Set doc1=nothing
				End If
			End If	
		Else
			kkd=Doc.d7MsgBox ("Aktivite Türü (Yurtiçi-Yurtdýþý) belirtilmeden cari kart açýlamaz. Ýþlem Ýptal.","Dinamo ERP",MB_OK)
			Exit Sub
	End If	

End Sub

Sub cmd_urunagacindangetir

	If Doc.GetDocType0 <> "TEKL40" Then Exit Sub

	Set SCF=Doc.GetTableObject("SCFOEN")
	Set T40T=Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
	StkKodVal = T40T.KOD

	Set rs_BOMU01T = Doc.Select1("__2", "BOMU01T", "BOMREC_CODE='" & StkKodVal & "' & AKTIF_PASIF= '*' & SGK_1='E' ", "", -1)
	KayitSayisi = rs_BOMU01T.GetRecCount 

	If KayitSayisi > 0 Then
		For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
			For j = 1 To SCF.GetrecCount
				FeatureKoduVal = SCF.FEATURENO(j)
				Set rs_S00OC = Doc.Select1("__3", "STOK00OC", "KOD='" & StkKodVal & "' & FEATURENO = '"& Trim(FeatureKoduVal) & "' & OPTION1='"& rs_BOMU01T.BOMREC_FO_OPTION(i) &"' ", "", -1)
				If rs_S00OC.GetRecCount > 0 Then
					SCF.OPTION1(j) = rs_BOMU01T.BOMREC_FO_OPTION(i)
	
					Exit For
				End If
				Set rs_S00OC = Nothing
			Next
		Next
	End If

	Set rs_BOMU01T = Nothing
	Set T40T = Nothing

	Doc.CallFieldAfterValidate_Table "SCFOEN","OPTION1"
End Sub

Sub Sanal_Teklif_Al()
	If Doc.GetDocType="TEKL40"Then
		Set FRM_S=Doc.GetTableObject("FRM_SANAL")
		Set T40T=Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
		FRM_S.SafePack

		satirr=T40T.getCurrentRow
		EskiTeklif=Trim(T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_16(satirr))

		satirno=Trim(T40T.REFTEXT01(satirr))

		If EskiTeklif<>"" and satirno<>"" Then
			Set T40TT=Doc.Select1("sdsfds","TEKL40T","EVRAKNO='"&EskiTeklif&"'&REFTEXT01='"&satirno&"'","",-1)
			For j=1 To T40TT.GetRecCount
				If Left(Trim(T40TT.KOD(j)),1)="8" Then
					satir=FRM_S.AddRow()

					FRM_S.KOD(satir)=T40TT.KOD(j)
					FRM_S.AD(satir)=Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",T40TT.KOD(j),"")
				End If
			Next
		End If

	ElseIf Doc.GetDocType="STOK40" Then
		Set FRM_S=Doc.GetTableObject("FRM_SANAL")
		Set S40T=Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40T")
		FRM_S.SafePack
		satirr=S40T.getCurrentRow()
		Teklif=Trim(S40T.TEKLIFARTNO(satirr))
		satirno=Trim(S40T.ARTIKEL_REF_REF_3(satirr))
		If Teklif<>"" and satirno<>"" Then
			Set T40TT=Doc.Select1("sdsfds","TEKL40T","ARTNO='"&Teklif&"'&REFTEXT01='"&satirno&"'","",-1)
			OrjTeklifNo=Trim(T40TT.ARTIKEL_REF_REF_3)
			Set T40TTT=Doc.Select1("sdsfds","TEKL40T","EVRAKNO='"&OrjTeklifNo&"'&REFTEXT01='"&satirno&"'","",-1)
			For j=1 To T40TTT.GetRecCount
				If Left(Trim(T40TTT.KOD(j)),1)="8" Then
					satir=FRM_S.AddRow()
					FRM_S.KOD(satir)=T40TTT.KOD(j)
					FRM_S.AD(satir)=Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",T40TTT.KOD(j),"")
				End If
			Next
		End If

	End If
End Sub


Sub FO_Eslestir()
		Set FRM_S=Doc.GetTableObject("FRM_SANAL")
		Set SCF=Doc.GetTableObject("SCFOEN")

		For i= 1 To FRM_S.GetRecCount
			Kod=FRM_S.KOD(i)
			Set S00C=Doc.Select1("saddasd","STOK00OC","KOD='"&kod&"'","",-1)

			For j= 1 To SCF.GetRecCount
				If Trim(SCF.FEATURENO(j))=Trim(S00C.FEATURENO) Then
					'SCF.SetCurrentRow(j)
					'SCF.OPTION1(j)=S00C.OPTION1
				End IF
			Next
		Next
End Sub

Makro Kodu Sekmesi : 

Sub cmd_ozelmpshesapla
	Set M10E = Doc.GetTableObject("MMPS10E")
	Set MLVLMPS = Doc.GetTableObject("MULTILEVELMPS")
	MLVLMPS.Empty

	MpsNoVal = M10E.EVRAKNO
	MpsHedefKodVal = M10E.MAMULSTOKKODU
	MpsHedefKodAdiVal = M10E.MAMULSTOKKODU_STOK00_AD
	MpsHedefKodBirimiVal = M10E.SF_SF_UNIT

	FOVal = M10E.FOKOD_MAMULKODU
	MPSToplamMiktarVal = M10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR
	MPSUretilenMiktarVal = M10E.SF_URETILEN
	MPSPlanVal = M10E.HAVUZKODU
	MPSStatuVal = M10E.STATUS
	MPSUretimdenTeslimTarVal = M10E.URETIMDENTESTARIH
	MPSPaketSayisiVal = M10E.SF_PAKETSAYISI
	MPSPaketIcerigiVal = M10E.SF_PAKETICERIGI
	MPSTolTypeVal = M10E.TOLERANSTYPE
	MPSTolVal = M10E.TOLERANS
	MPSNotlar1Val = M10E.NOTLAR_1

	'SQL = " SELECT BOMTRV.*, STOK00.AD KAYNAKKODADI, STOK00.IUNIT KAYNAKKODBIRIMI FROM BOM_TRAVERSE00(10, '"& MpsHedefKodVal &"', '"& MPSToplamMiktarVal &"', '', '"& FOVal &"') BOMTRV "
	'SQL = SQL & "LEFT JOIN BOMU01E ON BOMU01E.MAMULCODE = BOMTRV.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE AND BOMU01E.AKTIF_PASIF = '*' "
	'SQL = SQL & "LEFT JOIN STOK00 ON STOK00.KOD = BOMTRV.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE  "
	'SQL = SQL & "WHERE 1=1  "
	'SQL = SQL & "AND SEVIYE <= "& SeviyeVal &" "
	'SQL = SQL & "AND LEFT(BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE,2) <> '10' "
	'SQL = SQL & "AND BOMREC_INPUTTYPE = 'H' "
	'SQL = SQL & "AND BOMU01E.EVRAKNO <> '' "
	'Set MPSBOM = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dde34r55", SQL)

	SQL = " SELECT MMPS10T.*, STOK00.AD URETILENSTOKAD, STOK00.IUNIT URETILENSTOKBIRIM FROM MMPS10T "

	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN BOMU01E ON BOMU01E.MAMULCODE = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU AND BOMU01E.AKTIF_PASIF = '*'  "
	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN STOK00 ON STOK00.KOD = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU  "

	SQL = SQL & " WHERE 1=1 "
	SQL = SQL & " AND MMPS10T.EVRAKNO = '"& MpsNoVal &"' "
	SQL = SQL & " AND R_KAYNAKTYPE = 'H' "
	SQL = SQL & " AND BOMU01E.EVRAKNO <> '' "
	
	SQL = SQL & " ORDER BY SRNUM "

	Set MPSBOM = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dde34r55", SQL)

	If MPSBOM.GetRecCount = 0 Then
		msgbox "Kayýt Bulunamadý..."

		Exit Sub
	End If

	'************** Referans MPS *****************
	SatirNo = MLVLMPS.AddRow
	MLVLMPS.SetCurrentRow SatirNo

	MLVLMPS.SELECTED1 = "1"
	MLVLMPS.LEVELNO = "0"
	MLVLMPS.EVRAKNO = MpsNoVal
	MLVLMPS.MPSNO = MMpsNoVal
	MLVLMPS.ANAMPS = ""
	MLVLMPS.KAYNAKMPS = ""
	MLVLMPS.KAYNAKMPS_SRNUM = ""
	MLVLMPS.KAYNAKMPS_TRNUM = ""

	MLVLMPS.COKURUNLUMU10 = ""
	MLVLMPS.HAVUZKODU = MPSPlanVal
	MLVLMPS.STATUS = MPSStatuVal
	MLVLMPS.URETIMDENTESTARIH = MPSUretimdenTeslimTarVal
	MLVLMPS.MAMULSTOKKODU = MpsHedefKodVal
	MLVLMPS.MAMULSTOKKODU_STOK00_AD = MpsHedefKodAdiVal
	MLVLMPS.SF_PAKETSAYISI = MPSPaketSayisiVal
	MLVLMPS.SF_PAKETICERIGI = MPSPaketIcerigiVal
	MLVLMPS.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR = MPSToplamMiktarVal
	MLVLMPS.SF_SF_UNIT = MpsHedefKodBirimiVal
	MLVLMPS.URETILENMAMUL = ""
	MLVLMPS.URETILENMAMUL_AD = ""
	MLVLMPS.URETILENMAMUL_MIKTARI = MPSUretilenMiktarVal
	MLVLMPS.TOLERANSTYPE = MPSTolTypeVal
	MLVLMPS.TOLERANS = MPSTolVal
	MLVLMPS.FOKOD_MAMULKODU = FOVal
	MLVLMPS.NOTLAR_1 = MPSNotlar1Val
	'*******************************

	For i = 1 to MPSBOM.GetRecCount
		UretilenStokKodu = MPSBOM.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
		UretilenStokAdi = MPSBOM.URETILENSTOKAD(i)
		UretilenStokBirimi = MPSBOM.URETILENSTOKBIRIM(i)

		SatirNo = MLVLMPS.AddRow
		MLVLMPS.SetCurrentRow SatirNo
		
		MLVLMPS.SELECTED1 = "1"
		MLVLMPS.LEVELNO = 1 'MPSBOM.SEVIYE(i)
		MLVLMPS.EVRAKNO = ""
		MLVLMPS.MPSNO = "#" & Right("00000000" & i, 9)  

		MLVLMPS.ANAMPS = ""
		MLVLMPS.KAYNAKMPS = MpsNoVal
		MLVLMPS.KAYNAKMPS_SRNUM = MPSBOM.srnum(i)
		MLVLMPS.KAYNAKMPS_TRNUM = ""

		MLVLMPS.COKURUNLUMU10 = ""
		MLVLMPS.HAVUZKODU = MPSBOM.R_HAVUZKODU(i)
		MLVLMPS.STATUS = MPSBOM.R_STATUS(i)
		MLVLMPS.URETIMDENTESTARIH = MPSBOM.REVURETIMDENTESTARIH(i)
		MLVLMPS.MAMULSTOKKODU = UretilenStokKodu
		MLVLMPS.MAMULSTOKKODU_STOK00_AD = UretilenStokAdi

		If MPSBOM.R_YMK_MPAKET(i) = 0 Then
			MLVLMPS.SF_PAKETSAYISI = 1
		Else
			MLVLMPS.SF_PAKETSAYISI = MPSBOM.R_YMK_MPAKET(i)
		End If

		MLVLMPS.SF_PAKETICERIGI = MPSBOM.R_MIKTAR0(i)
		
		MLVLMPS.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR = MLVLMPS.SF_PAKETSAYISI * MLVLMPS.SF_PAKETICERIGI
		MLVLMPS.SF_SF_UNIT = UretilenStokBirimi
		MLVLMPS.URETILENMAMUL = UretilenStokKodu
		MLVLMPS.URETILENMAMUL_AD = UretilenStokAdi
		MLVLMPS.URETILENMAMUL_MIKTARI = MLVLMPS.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR
		MLVLMPS.TOLERANSTYPE = ""
		MLVLMPS.TOLERANS = ""
		MLVLMPS.FOKOD_MAMULKODU = ""
		MLVLMPS.NOTLAR_1 = ""
	Next

End Sub

'--------------------
Sub cmd_Aktar

	Doc.RUN_APP_CANCEL 

	Set  MTable = Doc.GetTableObject("FRM_STACK_KRITERLER")

	StkKodVal1 = MTable.STKKOD1
	StkKodVal2 = MTable.STKKOD2
	DepoVal = MTable.AMBCODE
	StkGk1Val = MTable.STKGK1
	FokodVal = MTable.FOKOD
	AsamaKoduVal = MTable.VRI_RECETE

	If Trim(FokodVal) = "" and Trim(StkKodVal1) = "" and Trim(StkKodVal2) = ""  and Trim(DepoVal) = "" and Trim(StkGk1Val) = "" Then
		msgbox "Kod / Fokod / Depo / GK-1 alanlarýndan en az biri seçilmeli."

		Exit Sub
	End If

	SQL = " SELECT STOK01.KOD, SUM(SF_MIKTAR) SF_MIKTAR, GK_1, VRI_RECETE    "

	If Trim(DepoVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & " ,AMBCODE "
	If Trim(FokodVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & " ,STOK01.FOKOD "

	SQL = SQL & " FROM STOK01 "

	SQL = SQL & " LEFT JOIN STOK00 ON STOK00.KOD = STOK01.KOD "
	
	SQL = SQL & "  WHERE 1=1 "

	If Trim(StkKodVal1) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & " AND STOK01.KOD >= '"& StkKodVal1 &"' "
	If Trim(StkKodVal2) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & " AND STOK01.KOD <= '"& StkKodVal2 &"' "

	If Trim(StkGk1Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & " AND GK_1 IN ('"& StkGk1Val &"') "
	If Trim(DepoVal) <> "" Then SQL =SQL & " AND AMBCODE = '"& DepoVal &"' "
	If Trim(FokodVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & " AND FOKOD = '"& FokodVal &"' "
	If Trim(AsamaKoduVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & " AND VRI_RECETE = '"& AsamaKoduVal &"' "

	SQL = SQL & " GROUP BY "

	SQL = SQL & " STOK01.KOD, STOK00.GK_1, VRI_RECETE "

	If Trim(FokodVal) <> "" Then 
		SQL = SQL & " ,STOK01.FOKOD "
	End If

	If Trim(DepoVal) <> "" Then 
		SQL = SQL & " ,STOK01.AMBCODE "
	End If

	SQL = SQL & " ORDER BY STOK01.KOD, VRI_RECETE, GK_1 "

	If Trim(DepoVal) <> "" Then  SQL = SQL & " ,AMBCODE  "
	If Trim(FokodVal) <> "" Then  SQL = SQL & " ,FOKOD  "

	Set S01SQL = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dde34r55", SQL)

	If S01SQL.GetRecCount = 0 Then 
		msgbox "Kayýt Bulunamadý..."

		Exit Sub
	End If

	Set  SCCTP = Doc.GetTableObject("SCCHECKTP")
	SCCTP.Empty

	For i = 1 To S01SQL.GetRecCount 
		SatirNo = SCCTP.AddRow
		SCCTP.SetCurrentRow SatirNo

		SCCTP.KOD = S01SQL.KOD(i)
		SCCTP.SF_MIKTAR = S01SQL.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		If Trim(FokodVal) <> "" Then  SCCTP.FOKOD = S01SQL.FOKOD(i)
		SCCTP.SF_VRI_RECETE = S01SQL.VRI_RECETE(i)
	Next

	SCCTP.SetCurrentRow 1
End Sub

Makro Kodu Sekmesi : 

Sub cmd_Listele
	Call Listele_Detay
	Call Listele_Ozet
	Call Listele_Ozet_STKGK3
	Call Listele_Ozet_STOK_AD
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------
Sub Listele_Detay
	Set LSE = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTEE")

	TarihBas = LSE.TARIH1
	TarihBit = LSE.TARIH2
	SeriNo1Val = LSE.SERINO1
	SeriNo2Val = LSE.SERINO2

	StkGK3Val = LSE.STKGK3
	StkKodVal = LSE.STKKOD
	StkAdVal = LSE.STKAD
	FokodVal = LSE.FOKOD
	GarantiVal = LSE.GARANTI
	YI_YD_Val = LSE.SERVISGK2

	SQL = "SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    s.KOD AS SERVISFISNO," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    s.TARIH AS SERVISTARIHI," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    s.FIRMA AS SERVISYAPILANFIRMA," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    c1.AD AS SATISFATCARIAD," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    s.CIHAZKARTNO AS SERVISCIHAZNO," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    s.GARANTILIMI," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    sc.SERINO AS SERVISSERINO," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    sc.STOKKODU AS TANIMLIPARCAKODU," & vbCrLf

	SQL = SQL & "    a.EVRAKNOAS SATISFAT_EVRAKNO," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.CH_KODU AS SATISFAT_CARIKOD," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.KOD AS SATISFAT_STKKODU," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.STOK_AD AS SATISFAT_STKADI," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.STKGK3 AS SATISFAT_STKGK3," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.SERINO AS SATISFAT_SERINO," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD AS SATISFAT_FOKOD, " & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD_AD1 AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD1, " & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD_AD2 AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD2, " & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD_AD3 AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD3, " & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD_AD4 AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD4, " & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD_AD5 AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD5, " & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD_AD6 AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD6, " & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD_AD7 AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD7, " & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD_AD8 AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD8, " & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD_AD9 AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD9, " & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    a.FOKOD_AD10 ASSATISFAT_FOKOD_AD10 " & vbCrLf

	SQL = SQL & "FROM dbo.SRVS00 AS s" & vbCrLf

	SQL = SQL & "LEFT JOIN dbo.CARI00 AS c1 ON c1.KOD = s.FIRMA" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "LEFT JOIN dbo.SRVSC0 AS sc ON sc.KOD = s.CIHAZKARTNO" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "INNER JOIN dbo.STOK70T_ALL AS a" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    ON RTRIM(a.SERINO) = RTRIM(sc.SERINO)" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "   AND RTRIM(a.CH_KODU) = RTRIM(s.FIRMA)" & vbCrLf

	SQL = SQL & "WHERE 1=1 " & vbCrLf
	'SQL = SQL & "  AND s.GK_2 = 'YI'" & vbCrLf

	If Trim(YI_YD_Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND RTRIM(s.GK_2) = '" & Replace(YI_YD_Val, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf

	If Trim(TarihBas) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND s.TARIH >= '" & Replace(TarihBas, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf
	If Trim(TarihBit) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND s.TARIH <= '" & Replace(TarihBit, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf

	If Trim(SeriNo1Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND sc.SERINO >= '" & Replace(SeriNo1Val, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf
	If Trim(SeriNo2Val) <> "" ThenSQL = SQL & "  AND sc.SERINO <= '" & Replace(SeriNo2Val, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf

	If Trim(StkGK3Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND RTRIM(a.STKGK3) = '" & Replace(StkGK3Val, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf

	If Trim(StkKodVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND a.KOD = '" & Replace(StkKodVal, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkAdVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND a.STOK_AD LIKE '%" & Trim(StkAdVal) & "%' " & vbCrLf
	If Trim(FokodVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND a.FOKOD = '" & Replace(FokodVal, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf

	If Trim(GarantiVal) <> "" Then 
		If GarantiVal = "E" Then 
			SQL = SQL & "  AND s.GARANTILIMI = 'E' " & vbCrLf

		ElseIf GarantiVal = "H" Then 
			SQL = SQL & "  AND s.GARANTILIMI = 'H' " & vbCrLf
		End If
	End If

	SQL = SQL & " ORDER BY a.KOD, a.CH_KODU "

	Set SVS00SQLDETAYDOLU = Doc.RunSQLQuery("SVS00_SQL_DETAYDOLU", SQL)

	Set SVS00SQLDETAY = Doc.GetTableObject("SVS00_SQL_DETAY")
	SVS00SQLDETAY.Empty

	SVS00SQLDETAY.CopyTable(SVS00SQLDETAYDOLU)

	SVS00SQLDETAY.SetCurrentRow 1

End Sub
'------------------------------------------------
Sub Listele_Ozet
	Set LSE = Doc.GetTableObject("LISTEE")

	TarihBas = LSE.TARIH1
	TarihBit = LSE.TARIH2
	SeriNo1Val = LSE.SERINO1
	SeriNo2Val = LSE.SERINO2

	StkGK3Val = LSE.STKGK3
	StkKodVal = LSE.STKKOD
	StkAdVal = LSE.STKAD
	FokodVal = LSE.FOKOD
	GarantiVal = LSE.GARANTI
	YI_YD_Val = LSE.SERVISGK2

	SQL = "SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    q.gK AS SATISFAT_STKKODU," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    q.gS AS SATISFAT_STKADI," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    q.gF AS SATISFAT_FOKOD," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    q.gT AS SATISFAT_STKGK3," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.EVRAKNO) AS SATISFAT_EVRAKNO," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.SERINO) AS SATISFAT_SERINO," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.FOKOD_AD1) AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD1," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.FOKOD_AD2) AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD2," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.FOKOD_AD3) AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD3," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.FOKOD_AD4) AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD4," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.FOKOD_AD5) AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD5," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.FOKOD_AD6) AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD6," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.FOKOD_AD7) AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD7," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.FOKOD_AD8) AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD8," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.FOKOD_AD9) AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD9," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.FOKOD_AD10) AS SATISFAT_FOKOD_AD10," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    CAST(SUM(ISNULL(q.SF, 0)) AS decimal(18, 4)) AS TOPLAM_SF_MIKTAR," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    CAST(MAX(ISNULL(q.fis_cnt, 0)) AS int) AS SERVIS_FIS_SAYISI" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "FROM (" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        l.gK, l.gS, l.gF, l.gT," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        l.KaynakDb, l.CH_KODU, l.KOD, l.SERINO, l.FOKOD, l.EVRAKNO," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        l.SF," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        l.FOKOD_AD1, l.FOKOD_AD2, l.FOKOD_AD3, l.FOKOD_AD4,l.FOKOD_AD5," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        l.FOKOD_AD6, l.FOKOD_AD7, l.FOKOD_AD8, l.FOKOD_AD9, l.FOKOD_AD10," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        ISNULL(f.fis_cnt, 0) AS fis_cnt" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    FROM (" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.KOD AS nvarchar(100))), N'') AS gK," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.STOK_AD AS nvarchar(200))), N'') AS gS," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.FOKOD AS nvarchar(30))), N'') AS gF," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.STKGK3 AS nvarchar(20))), N'') AS gT," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            a.KaynakDb, a.CH_KODU, a.KOD, a.SERINO, a.FOKOD, a.EVRAKNO," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(ISNULL(a.SF_MIKTAR, 0)) AS SF," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD1) AS FOKOD_AD1," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD2) AS FOKOD_AD2," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD3) AS FOKOD_AD3," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD4) AS FOKOD_AD4," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD5) AS FOKOD_AD5," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD6) AS FOKOD_AD6," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD7) AS FOKOD_AD7," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD8) AS FOKOD_AD8," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD9) AS FOKOD_AD9," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD10) AS FOKOD_AD10" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        FROM dbo.SRVS00 AS s" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        INNER JOIN dbo.SRVSC0 AS sc ON sc.KOD = s.CIHAZKARTNO" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        INNER JOIN dbo.STOK70T_ALL AS a" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            ON RTRIM(a.SERINO) = RTRIM(sc.SERINO)" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "           AND RTRIM(a.CH_KODU) = RTRIM(s.FIRMA)" & vbCrLf

	SQL = SQL & "        WHERE 1=1 " & vbCrLf
	'SQL = SQL & "          AND s.GK_2 = 'YI'" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "          AND LEN(RTRIM(a.SERINO)) > 0" & vbCrLf

	If Trim(YI_YD_Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND RTRIM(s.GK_2) = '" & Replace(YI_YD_Val, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf

	If Trim(TarihBas) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND s.TARIH >= '" & Replace(TarihBas, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(TarihBit) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND s.TARIH <= '" & Replace(TarihBit, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(SeriNo1Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND sc.SERINO >= '" & Replace(SeriNo1Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(SeriNo2Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND sc.SERINO <= '" & Replace(SeriNo2Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkGK3Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND RTRIM(a.STKGK3) = '" & Replace(StkGK3Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkKodVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND a.KOD = '" & Replace(StkKodVal, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkAdVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND a.STOK_AD LIKE '%" & Trim(StkAdVal) & "%' " & vbCrLf
	If Trim(FokodVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND a.FOKOD = '" & Replace(FokodVal, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf

	If Trim(GarantiVal) <> "" Then 
		If GarantiVal = "E" Then 
			SQL = SQL & "  AND s.GARANTILIMI = 'E' " & vbCrLf
		ElseIf GarantiVal = "H" Then 
			SQL = SQL & "  AND s.GARANTILIMI = 'H' " & vbCrLf
		End If
	End If

	SQL = SQL & "        GROUP BY" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.KOD AS nvarchar(100))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.STOK_AD AS nvarchar(200))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.FOKOD AS nvarchar(30))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.STKGK3 AS nvarchar(20))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            a.KaynakDb, a.CH_KODU, a.KOD, a.SERINO, a.FOKOD, a.EVRAKNO" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    ) AS l" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    LEFT JOIN (" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.KOD AS nvarchar(100))), N'') AS gK2," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.STOK_AD AS nvarchar(200))), N'') AS gS2," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.FOKOD AS nvarchar(30))), N'') AS gF2," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.STKGK3 AS nvarchar(20))), N'') AS gT2," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COUNT(DISTINCT s2.KOD) AS fis_cnt" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        FROM dbo.SRVS00 AS s2" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        INNER JOIN dbo.SRVSC0 AS sc2 ON sc2.KOD = s2.CIHAZKARTNO" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        INNER JOIN dbo.STOK70T_ALL AS a2" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            ON RTRIM(a2.SERINO) = RTRIM(sc2.SERINO)" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "           AND RTRIM(a2.CH_KODU) = RTRIM(s2.FIRMA)" & vbCrLf

	SQL = SQL & "        WHERE 1=1 " & vbCrLf
	'SQL = SQL & "          AND s2.GK_2 = 'YI'" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "          AND LEN(RTRIM(a2.SERINO)) > 0" & vbCrLf

	If Trim(YI_YD_Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND RTRIM(s2.GK_2) ='" & Replace(YI_YD_Val, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf

	If Trim(TarihBas) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND s2.TARIH >= '" & Replace(TarihBas, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(TarihBit) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND s2.TARIH <= '" & Replace(TarihBit, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(SeriNo1Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND sc2.SERINO >= '" & Replace(SeriNo1Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(SeriNo2Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND sc2.SERINO <= '" & Replace(SeriNo2Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkGK3Val) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND RTRIM(a2.STKGK3) = '" & Replace(StkGK3Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkKodVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND a2.KOD = '" & Replace(StkKodVal, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkAdVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "  AND a2.STOK_AD LIKE '%" & Trim(StkAdVal) & "%' " & vbCrLf
	If Trim(FokodVal) <> "" Then SQL = SQL & "          AND a2.FOKOD = '" & Replace(FokodVal, "'", "''") & "'"& vbCrLf

	If Trim(GarantiVal) <> "" Then 
		If GarantiVal = "E" Then 
			SQL = SQL & "  AND s2.GARANTILIMI = 'E' " & vbCrLf
		ElseIf GarantiVal = "H" Then 
			SQL = SQL & "  AND s2.GARANTILIMI = 'H' " & vbCrLf
		End If
	End If

	SQL = SQL & "        GROUP BY" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.KOD AS nvarchar(100))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.STOK_AD AS nvarchar(200))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.FOKOD AS nvarchar(30))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.STKGK3 AS nvarchar(20))), N'')" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    ) AS f" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        ON f.gK2 = l.gK AND f.gS2 = l.gS AND f.gF2 = l.gF AND f.gT2 = l.gT" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & ") AS q" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "GROUP BY" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    q.gK, q.gS, q.gF, q.gT" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "ORDER BY" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    MAX(q.fis_cnt) DESC, q.gK, q.gS, q.gF, q.gT"

	Set SVS00OZETSQLDOLU = Doc.RunSQLQuery("SVS00_OZET_SQLDOLU", SQL)

	Set SVS00SQLOZET = Doc.GetTableObject("SVS00_SQL_OZET")
	SVS00SQLOZET.Empty
	SVS00SQLOZET.CopyTable(SVS00OZETSQLDOLU)
	SVS00SQLOZET.SetCurrentRow 1
End Sub

	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.FOKOD AS nvarchar(30))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.STKGK3 AS nvarchar(20))), N'')" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "    ) AS f" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        ON f.gK2 = l.gK AND f.gS2 = l.gS AND f.gF2 = l.gF AND f.gT2= l.gT" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & ") AS q" & vbCrLf

	SQL = "SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    lin.gT AS SATISFAT_STKGK3," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    CAST(SUM(lin.SF_SUM) AS decimal(18, 0)) AS TOPLAM_SF_MIKTAR," & vbCrLf

End Sub

	GarantiVal = LSE.GARANTI
	YI_YD_Val = LSE.SERVISGK2

	SQL_Q = "    SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        l.gK, l.gS, l.gF, l.gT," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        l.KaynakDb, l.CH_KODU, l.KOD, l.SERINO, l.FOKOD, l.EVRAKNO," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        l.SF," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        l.FOKOD_AD1, l.FOKOD_AD2, l.FOKOD_AD3, l.FOKOD_AD4, l.FOKOD_AD5," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        l.FOKOD_AD6, l.FOKOD_AD7, l.FOKOD_AD8, l.FOKOD_AD9, l.FOKOD_AD10," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        ISNULL(f.fis_cnt, 0) AS fis_cnt" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "    FROM (" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.KOD AS nvarchar(100))), N'') AS gK," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.STOK_AD AS nvarchar(200))), N'') AS gS," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.FOKOD AS nvarchar(30))), N'') AS gF," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.STKGK3 AS nvarchar(20))), N'') AS gT," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            a.KaynakDb, a.CH_KODU, a.KOD, a.SERINO, a.FOKOD, a.EVRAKNO," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(ISNULL(a.SF_MIKTAR, 0)) AS SF," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD1) AS FOKOD_AD1," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD2) AS FOKOD_AD2," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD3) AS FOKOD_AD3," &vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD4) AS FOKOD_AD4," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD5) AS FOKOD_AD5," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD6) AS FOKOD_AD6," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD7) AS FOKOD_AD7," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD8) AS FOKOD_AD8," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD9) AS FOKOD_AD9," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            MAX(a.FOKOD_AD10) AS FOKOD_AD10" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        FROM dbo.SRVS00 AS s" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        INNER JOIN dbo.SRVSC0 AS sc ON sc.KOD = s.CIHAZKARTNO" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        INNER JOIN dbo.STOK70T_ALL AS a" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            ON RTRIM(a.SERINO) = RTRIM(sc.SERINO)" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "           AND RTRIM(a.CH_KODU) = RTRIM(s.FIRMA)" & vbCrLf

	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        WHERE 1=1 " & vbCrLf
	'SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND s.GK_2 = 'YI'" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND LEN(RTRIM(a.SERINO)) > 0" & vbCrLf

	If Trim(YI_YD_Val) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "  AND RTRIM(s.GK_2) = '" & Replace(YI_YD_Val, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf

	If Trim(TarihBas) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND s.TARIH >= '" & Replace(TarihBas, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(TarihBit) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND s.TARIH <= '" & Replace(TarihBit, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(SeriNo1Val) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND sc.SERINO >= '" & Replace(SeriNo1Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(SeriNo2Val) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND sc.SERINO <= '" & Replace(SeriNo2Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkGK3Val) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND RTRIM(a.STKGK3) = '" & Replace(StkGK3Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkKodVal) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND a.KOD = '" & Replace(StkKodVal, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkAdVal) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "  AND a.STOK_AD LIKE '%" & Trim(StkAdVal) & "%' " & vbCrLf
	If Trim(FokodVal) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND a.FOKOD = '" & Replace(FokodVal, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf

	If Trim(GarantiVal) <> "" Then 
		If GarantiVal = "E" Then 
			SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "  AND s.GARANTILIMI = 'E' " & vbCrLf
		ElseIf GarantiVal = "H" Then 
			SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "  AND s.GARANTILIMI = 'H' " & vbCrLf
		End If
	End If

	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        GROUP BY" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.KOD AS nvarchar(100))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.STOK_AD AS nvarchar(200))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.FOKOD AS nvarchar(30))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a.STKGK3 AS nvarchar(20))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            a.KaynakDb, a.CH_KODU, a.KOD, a.SERINO, a.FOKOD, a.EVRAKNO" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "    ) AS l" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "    LEFT JOIN (" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.KOD AS nvarchar(100))), N'') AS gK2," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.STOK_AD AS nvarchar(200))), N'') AS gS2," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.FOKOD AS nvarchar(30))), N'') AS gF2," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.STKGK3 AS nvarchar(20))), N'') AS gT2," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COUNT(DISTINCT s2.KOD) AS fis_cnt" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        FROM dbo.SRVS00 AS s2" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        INNER JOIN dbo.SRVSC0 AS sc2 ON sc2.KOD = s2.CIHAZKARTNO" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        INNER JOIN dbo.STOK70T_ALL AS a2" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            ON RTRIM(a2.SERINO) = RTRIM(sc2.SERINO)" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "           AND RTRIM(a2.CH_KODU) = RTRIM(s2.FIRMA)" & vbCrLf

	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        WHERE 1=1 " & vbCrLf
	'SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "AND s2.GK_2 = 'YI'" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND LEN(RTRIM(a2.SERINO)) > 0" & vbCrLf

	If Trim(YI_YD_Val) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "  AND RTRIM(s2.GK_2) = '" & Replace(YI_YD_Val, "'", "''") & "' " & vbCrLf

	If Trim(TarihBas) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND s2.TARIH >= '" & Replace(TarihBas, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(TarihBit) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND s2.TARIH <= '" & Replace(TarihBit, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(SeriNo1Val) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND sc2.SERINO >= '" & Replace(SeriNo1Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(SeriNo2Val) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND sc2.SERINO <= '" & Replace(SeriNo2Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkGK3Val) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND RTRIM(a2.STKGK3) = '" & Replace(StkGK3Val, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkKodVal) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND a2.KOD = '" & Replace(StkKodVal, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf
	If Trim(StkAdVal) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "  AND a2.STOK_AD LIKE '%" & Trim(StkAdVal) & "%' " & vbCrLf
	If Trim(FokodVal) <> "" Then SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "          AND a2.FOKOD = '" & Replace(FokodVal, "'", "''") & "'" & vbCrLf

	If Trim(GarantiVal) <> "" Then 
		If GarantiVal = "E" Then 
			SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "  AND s2.GARANTILIMI = 'E' " & vbCrLf
		ElseIf GarantiVal = "H" Then 
			SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "  AND s2.GARANTILIMI = 'H' " & vbCrLf
		End If
	End If

	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        GROUP BY" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.KOD AS nvarchar(100))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.STOK_AD AS nvarchar(200))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.FOKOD AS nvarchar(30))), N'')," & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "            COALESCE(RTRIM(CAST(a2.STKGK3 AS nvarchar(20))), N'')" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "    ) AS f" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & "        ON f.gK2 = l.gK AND f.gS2 = l.gS AND f.gF2 = l.gF AND f.gT2 = l.gT" & vbCrLf
	SQL_Q = SQL_Q & ") AS q" & vbCrLf

	SQL = "SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    lin.gS AS SATISFAT_STKADI," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    CAST(SUM(lin.SF_SUM) AS decimal(18, 0)) AS TOPLAM_SF_MIKTAR," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    CAST(SUM(lin.FIS_MAX) AS int) AS SERVIS_FIS_SAYISI" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "FROM (" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    SELECT" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        q.gT," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        q.gK," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        q.gS," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        q.gF," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(q.SF, 0)) AS decimal(18, 0)) AS SF_SUM," & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "        CAST(MAX(ISNULL(q.fis_cnt, 0)) AS int) AS FIS_MAX" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    FROM (" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & SQL_Q
	SQL = SQL & "    GROUP BY q.gT, q.gK, q.gS, q.gF" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & ") AS lin" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "GROUP BY lin.gS" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "ORDER BY" & vbCrLf
	SQL = SQL & "    SERVIS_FIS_SAYISI DESC, SATISFAT_STKADI"

	Set SVS00OZETStokAd = Doc.RunSQLQuery("SVS00_OZET_STOKADI_SQLDOLU", SQL)

	Set SVS00SQLOZETStokAd = Doc.GetTableObject("SVS00_SQL_OZET_STOKADI")
	SVS00SQLOZETStokAd.Empty
	SVS00SQLOZETStokAd.CopyTable(SVS00OZETStokAd)
	SVS00SQLOZETStokAd.SetCurrentRow 1
End Sub

Makro Kodu Sekmesi : 

Sub Kalite()
	Set S29T=Doc.GetTableObject("STOK29T")
	satir=S29T.GetCurrentrow
	Lotno=Trim(S29T.LOTNUMBER(satir))
	Kod=Trim(S29T.KOD(satir))
	Set QVAL=Doc.Select1("aSAS","QVAL02E","LOTNUMBER='"&LotNo&"'&KOD='"&Kod&"'","",-1)
	If QVAL.GetREcCount>0 Then
		Set Doc1=Doc.CreateDocumentUI("QVAL20","")
		set QVL=Doc1.GetTableObject("QVAL02E")
		nret=Doc1.Load_Voucher(QVAL.EVRAKNO)
	Else
		MsGbox "Seçili satýrýn kalite föyü oluþmamýþ.Ýþlem iptal."
	End If
End Sub

Sub cmd_UretimEmriOnIzleme
	UserMailVal = ""

	Set UDFTABLE = Doc.Select1("DDD", "UDEF", "KOD='"& Doc.Getd7UserName &"' & EMAIL <> '' ", "", -1)
	If UDFTABLE.GetRecCount > 0 Then
		UserMailVal = Trim(UDFTABLE.EMAIL(1))
	End If

	'strmail = inputbox("Ön izleme için e-mail adresi giriniz","Üretim Emri Ön Ýzleme", UserMailVal)

	'If Trim(strmail)="" Then 
		'msgbox "E-MAÝL Boþ." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Mail Gönderilmeyecektir."
	'End If

	Call SendEkliPdfMail("OnIzleme", UserMailVal)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------
Sub SendEkliPdfMail(MailKonusu, MailList)
	If Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName) ="BT" Then
		emailval = "recep.deniz@ozak-t.com"

		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("e-Mail sadece ( " & emailval & " ) Adresine mi Gönderilsin?", "Uyarý", MB_YESNO)

		If k =  6 Then 
			MailList = emailval
		End If
	End If

	par1 = MailKonusu
	par2 = MailList

	Doc.RunMacro2 "PFRM7S.URETIM-PDF", "PrintForm2", par1, par2
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub cmd_Onay1
	Set S40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")
	Set ZUS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_STOK40E")
	KullaniciVal = Doc.Getd7UserName
	OzelYetkiKodu = "STS_ONAY1"

	If Not OzelHakVarMi(OzelYetkiKodu) Then
		msgbox "Kullanýcý Tanýmlarýnda ( Planlama ) için Onay Verme Yetkiniz Tanýmlanmamýþ. " & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Özel Yetki Kodu : [ " & OzelYetkiKodu &  " ]"

		Exit Sub
	End If

	If ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK <> "E" Then
		Msgbox "Önce Onay için Ürün Grubu Seçimini Sonlandýrýn."

		Exit Sub
	End If

	' ***************** önceki onaylar tamamlanmýþ mý kontrolü ************
	OncekiOnaylar = True
	msg = ""

	If ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_2 = "E" Then
		If Trim(ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_2) = "" Then
			msg = "AGS Onayý Verilmeli."
			OncekiOnaylar = False
		End If
	End If

	If ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_3 = "E" Then
		If Trim(ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_3) = "" Then
			OncekiOnaylar = False
			If trim(msg) <> "" Then 
				msg = msg & vbcrlf & "YGS Onayý Verilmeli."
			Else
				msg = "YGS Onayý Verilmeli."
			End If
		End If

		If Trim(ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_4) = "" Then
			OncekiOnaylar = False

			If trim(msg) <> "" Then 
				msg = msg & vbcrlf & "YGS Proje Onayý Verilmeli."
			Else
				msg = "YGS Proje Onayý Verilmeli."
			End If
		End If
	End If
	
	If Not OncekiOnaylar Then
		msgbox "Önce Aþaðýdaki Onay/lar Verilmelidir." & vbcrlf & "---------------------------------------" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & msg
	
		Exit Sub
	End If 

	'*********************************************************************
	If Trim(ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1) = "" Then
		ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1 = KullaniciVal
		ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_1 = Doc.Bugun
		ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_1 = Doc.Saat(5)
	Else
		ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_1 = ""
	End If
	
	'**************** email at *******************************
	k=Doc.d7MsgBox("Evrakda Gerekli Onaylar Tamamlanmýþ." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Onay Süreci Tamamlansýn mý?", "Uyarý", MB_YESNO)
	
	If k=vbYes Then
		S40E.ONAY = "E" 
	
		For i = 1 To 4
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 1
		Next
	Else
		S40E.ONAY = "H" 

		ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_1 = ""

		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_1", "BCKCOL", "YELLOW"
		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_1", "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_1", "READONLY", 0

		Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls
	
		Exit Sub
	End If

	Call OnayYetkiKontrol

	nret = Doc.Save_Voucher
	
	If nret <> 0 Then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox("Evrak Kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir", "Uyarý", MB_OK)

		S40E.ONAY = "H" 

		ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_1 = ""

		For i = 1 To 4
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 0
		Next

		Call OnayYetkiKontrol

		Exit Sub
	End If

	Call OnayYetkiKontrol

	Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls

	'********************** MAÝL AT ****************************
	
	MailList = ""

	MailList = GetButonOnayMailler

	If MailList <> "" Then
		MailKonusu = "[ " & Trim(ZUS40E.EVRAKNO) & GetMusteriKisaAd("") & " ] No' lu Satýþ Sipariþine Ait Onay Süreci Tamamlanmýþtýr.(UEIA)"

		Call SendEkliPdfMail(MailKonusu, MailList)	
	End If
End Sub
'-------------------------------------
Function GetMusteriKisaAd(Main_or_Temp)
	GetMusteriKisaAd = ""
	Set S40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")

	'********** cari kýsa ad *****************
	MusteriAdKisa = Trim(Left(Trim(S40E.MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_AD), 15))

	Do While InStr(MusteriAdKisa, "  ") > 0
		MusteriAdKisa = Replace(MusteriAdKisa, "  ", " ")
	Loop

	MusteriAdKisa = Replace(MusteriAdKisa, " ", "_")
	MusteriAdKisa = Replace(MusteriAdKisa, ",", "_")
	MusteriAdKisa = Replace(MusteriAdKisa, ".", "_")

	' Sona _ geldiyse kaldýr
	If Right(MusteriAdKisa, 1) = "_" Then
		MusteriAdKisa = Left(MusteriAdKisa, Len(MusteriAdKisa) - 1)
	End If

	RevNo = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK40E", Trim(S40E.EVRAKNO), "REVNO", 0))
	'***************************************

	DosyaAdiEk = MusteriAdKisa

	If RevNo <> "" Then
		DosyaAdiEk = "_" & MusteriAdKisa & "_" & "Rev_" & RevNo
	Else
		DosyaAdiEk = "_" & MusteriAdKisa
	End If
	
	If Main_or_Temp = "Gecici" Then
		DosyaAdiEk = DosyaAdiEk & "_Gecici"
	End If

	GetMusteriKisaAd = DosyaAdiEk
End Function

Function GetButonOnayMailler
	Set S40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")

	MailListX = ""

	If Trim(S40E.GK_1) = "YD" Then 
		MailListX = "sales@ozak-t.com"

	ElseIf Trim(S40E.GK_1) = "YI" Then 
		MailListX = "onay.yis@ozak-t.com"
	End If

	If Trim(MailListX) <> "" Then
		MailListX = MailListX & ", uretimemri@ozak-t.com "
	Else
		MailListX = " uretimemri@ozak-t.com "
	End If

	GetButonOnayMailler = MailListX
End Function
'--------------------------------------------
Function GetKutuOnayliMailler
	Set ZUS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_STOK40E")

	MailListX = ""

	If ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_1 = "E" Then
		Kutu1_Mail =  "mehmet.zeybek@ozak-t.com"

		MailListX = Kutu1_Mail
	End If

	If ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_2 = "E" Then
		Kutu2_Mail =  "ridvan.ozyer@ozak-t.com"

		If Trim(MailListX) <> "" Then
			MailListX = MailListX & "," & Kutu2_Mail
		Else
			MailListX = Kutu2_Mail
		End If
	End If

	If ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_3 = "E" Then
		Kutu3_Mail =  "ercan.dayan@ozak-t.com, ensar.aktas@ozak-t.com"

		If Trim(MailListX) <> "" Then
			MailListX = MailListX & "," & Kutu3_Mail
		Else
			MailListX = Kutu3_Mail
		End If
	End If

	GetKutuOnayliMailler = MailListX
End Function

Sub cmd_OnaylarIptal
	If Not OzelHakVarMi("TOÝ") Then
		msgbox "Tüm Onaylar Ýptal Etmek için Yetkiniz Yok." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Kullanýcý Tanýmlarý / Kullanýcý Tanýmlý Modül Haklarý Sekmesi" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Özel Yetki Kodu : [ TOÝ ]"

		Exit Sub
	End If

	KutuOnaylari = ""
	ButonOnaylari = ""

	Set S40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")
	Set ZUS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_STOK40E")

	KutuOnaylari = ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK
	ButonOnaylari = S40E.ONAY

	If S40E.ONAY <> "E" and ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK  = "H" Then
		msgbox "Ýptal Edilecek Onay Bulunamadý."

		Exit Sub
	End If

	k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Tüm Onaylar Ýptal Edilecek ve Evrak Kaydedilecek, emin misiniz?", "Dikkat", MB_YESNO)
	If k <> 6 Then Exit Sub

	'ÝPTAL ÖNCESÝ ONAYLAR

	KUTUONAY_1 = ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_1
	KUTUONAY_2 = ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_2
	KUTUONAY_3 = ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_3

	ONAYKULLANICI_1 = ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1
	ONAYTARIH_1 = ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_1
	ONAYSAAT_1 = ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_1

	ONAYKULLANICI_2 = ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_2
	ONAYTARIH_2 = ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_2
	ONAYSAAT_2 = ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_2

	ONAYKULLANICI_3 = ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_3
	ONAYTARIH_3 = ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_3
	ONAYSAAT_3 = ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_3

	ONAYKULLANICI_4 = ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_4
	ONAYTARIH_4 = ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_4
	ONAYSAAT_4 = ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_4

	If S40E.TARIH > "2025/12/09" Then
		S40E.ONAY = "H"
	End If

	For i = 1 To 3
		ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "KUTU_ONAY_"& i, 1, "H"

		ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_" & i, 1, ""
		ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_" & i, 1, ""
		ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_" & i, 1, ""
		
		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","KUTU_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 0
		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAYGRUPOK", "READONLY", 0
		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 0

		If i = 3 Then	
			ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_4", 1, ""
			ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_4", 1, ""
			ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_4", 1, ""
			
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAYGRUPOK", "READONLY", 0
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "READONLY", 1
		End If
	Next

	ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK  = "H"
	ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_1 = "E"
	Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","KUTU_ONAY_1", "READONLY", 1

	nret=Doc.Save_Voucher

	Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls

	If nret <> 0 Then
		S40E.ONAY = "E"
		ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK  = "E"

		msgbox "Evrak Kaydedilemedi."

		For i = 1 To 3
			If i=1 Then 
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1, KUTUONAY_1 
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_" & i, 1, ONAYKULLANICI_1
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_" & i, 1, ONAYTARIH_1
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_" & i, 1, ONAYSAAT_1
			End If

			If i=2 Then 
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1, KUTUONAY_2
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_" & i, 1, ONAYKULLANICI_2
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_" & i, 1, ONAYTARIH_2
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_" & i, 1, ONAYSAAT_2
			End If
	
			If i=3 Then 

				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1, KUTUONAY_3 
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_" & i, 1, ONAYKULLANICI_3
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_" & i, 1, ONAYTARIH_3
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_" & i, 1, ONAYSAAT_3

				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_4", 1, ONAYKULLANICI_4
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_4", 1, ONAYTARIH_4
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_4", 1, ONAYSAAT_4

				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4" , "READONLY", 1
			End If

			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","KUTU_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 1
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAYGRUPOK", "READONLY", 1
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 1
		Next

		Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls

		Exit Sub
	End If

	'**************** email at *******************************
	'19.12.2025 tariginde whatsupp talep üzerine iptal olduðunda mail gitmeyecek.

	'MailList = ""

	'If KutuOnaylari = "E" and ButonOnaylari = "E" Then
	'	MailList1 = GetKutuOnayliMailler
	'	MailList2 = GetButonOnayMailler
	'	MailList = MailList1 & ", " & MailList2
	'ElseIf KutuOnaylari = "E" Then
	'	MailList = GetKutuOnayliMailler
	'End If

	'If MailList <> "" Then
	'	MailKonusu = "[ " & Trim(ZUS40E.EVRAKNO) & GetMusteriKisaAd & " ] No' lu Satýþ Sipariþ Onay Süreci [ " & Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName) & " ] Kullanýcýsý Tarafýndan Ýptal Edilmiþtir.(TIE))" 

	'	Call SendEkliPdfMail(MailKonusu, MailList)	
	'End If
		
	Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------
Function GetMailList(MailStrVal)
	SQL = "SELECT STRING_AGG(TRIM(EMAIL), ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EMAIL) AS MAIL_LIST "
	SQL = SQL & "FROM UDEF "
	SQL = SQL & "WHERE KOD IN "
	SQL = SQL & "  ( SELECT KOD FROM UDEFT12 WHERE OZEL_HAK_KODU IN (" & MailStrVal & ") "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) "
	SQL = SQL & "AND TRIM(EMAIL) IS NOT NULL"

	Set MAILTABLE = Doc.RunSQLQuery("AtTTANBB", SQL)
	
	If MAILTABLE.GetRecCount > 0 Then
	    GetMailList = MAILTABLE.MAIL_LIST(1)
	Else
	    GetMailList = ""
	End If
End Function

Sub cmd_OnayGrubuSecimOK
	Set S40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")

	OzelYetkiKodu = "STS_OGRUP"

	If Not OzelHakVarMi(OzelYetkiKodu) Then
		msgbox "Kullanýcý Tanýmlarýnda Yetkiniz Tanýmlanmamýþ. " & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Özel Yetki Kodu : [ " & OzelYetkiKodu &  " ]"

		Exit Sub
	End If

	Set ZUS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_STOK40E")

	k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Ayarlar kaydedilecek ve ilgili kiþilere e-mail atýlacak,  emin misiniz?", "Uyarý", MB_YESNO)
	If k <> 6 Then Exit Sub

	ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK = "E"

	nret = Doc.Save_Voucher
	
	If nret <> 0 Then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox("Evrak Kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir", "Uyarý", MB_OK)

		ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK = "H"

		Exit Sub
	End If

	If nret = 0 Then
		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAYGRUPOK", "READONLY", 1

		For i = 2 To 3
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","KUTU_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 1
		Next
	End If

	Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls

	'**************** email at *******************************

	MailList = ""

	MailList = GetKutuOnayliMailler

	If MailList <> "" Then
		MailKonusu = "[ " & Trim(ZUS40E.EVRAKNO) & GetMusteriKisaAd("Gecici") & " ] Satýþ Sipariþi Açýlmýþ ve Tarafýnýza Onay Yetkisi Tanýmlanmýþtýr.(TSOA)" 

		Call SendEkliPdfMail(MailKonusu, MailList)	
	End If
End Sub

Function OzelHakVarMi(HakKodu)
	OzelHakVarMi = False
	Set U12 = Doc.Select1("de443d44t", "UDEFT12", "KOD='"& Doc.Getd7UserName() &"' & OZEL_HAK_KODU='" & HakKodu & "' ", "", -1)
	If U12.GetRowCount() > 0 Then OzelHakVarMi = True
End Function
'------------------------------------------------------
Sub OnayYetkiKontrol
	Set S40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")
	Set ZUS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_STOK40E")

	For i = 1 To 3
		If i=3 Then
			If ZUS40E.GetFieldValue("KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1) = "E" Then
				If Trim(ZUS40E.GetFieldValue("ONAY_KULLANICI_3", 1)) = "" Then  
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "BCKCOL", "YELLOW"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				Else
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "BCKCOL", "GREEN"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				End If

				'YGS PROJE
				If Trim(ZUS40E.GetFieldValue("ONAY_KULLANICI_4", 1)) = "" Then  
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "BCKCOL", "YELLOW"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				Else
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "BCKCOL", "GREEN"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				End If
			Else
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "BCKCOL", "GRAY"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "TXTCOL", "WHITE"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3" , "READONLY", 1

				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "BCKCOL", "GRAY"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "TXTCOL", "WHITE"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "READONLY", 1
			End If

		Else
			If ZUS40E.GetFieldValue("KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1) = "E" Then
				If Trim(ZUS40E.GetFieldValue("ONAY_KULLANICI_" & i, 1)) = "" Then  
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "BCKCOL", "YELLOW"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				Else
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "BCKCOL", "GREEN"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				End If
			Else
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "BCKCOL", "GRAY"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "TXTCOL", "WHITE"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 1
			End If
		End If
	Next

	Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls
End Sub

	Set Par=Nothing
	Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "FRM_ONAYDETAY", "EFRM10." & SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, Par

Sub cmd_emailtest 
	If Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName) <>"BT" Then
		msgbox "Sadece BT Kullanýcýsý için"

		Exit Sub
	End If

	Call SendEkliPdfMail("erp email test", "recep.deniz@ozak-t.com")
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------
Sub SendEkliPdfMail(MailKonusu, MailList)

	If Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName) ="BT" Then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("e-Mail sadece (recep.deniz@ozak-t.com) Adresine mi Gönderilsin?", "Uyarý", MB_YESNO)

		If k =  6 Then 
			MailList = "recep.deniz@ozak-t.com"
		End If
	End If

	par1 = MailKonusu
	par2 = MailList
	Doc.RunMacro2 "PFRM7S.URETIM-PDF", "PrintForm2", par1, par2
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GetButonOnayMailler
	Set S40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")

	MailListX = ""

	If Trim(S40E.GK_1) = "YD" Then 
		MailListX = "sales@ozak-t.com"
	ElseIf Trim(S40E.GK_1) = "YI" Then 
		MailListX = "yis@ozak-t.com"
	End If

	If Trim(MailListX) <> "" Then
		MailListX = MailListX & ", uretimemri@ozak-t.com "
	Else
		MailListX = " uretimemri@ozak-t.com "
	End If

	GetButonOnayMailler = MailListX
End Function
'--------------------------------------------
Function GetKutuOnayliMailler
	Set ZUS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_STOK40E")

	MailListX = ""

	If ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_1 = "E" Then
		Kutu1_Mail =  "mehmet.zeybek@ozak-t.com"

		MailListX = Kutu1_Mail
	End If

	If ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_2 = "E" Then
		Kutu2_Mail =  "ridvan.ozyer@ozak-t.com"

		If Trim(MailListX) <> "" Then
			MailListX = MailListX & "," & Kutu2_Mail
		Else
			MailListX = Kutu2_Mail
		End If
	End If

	If ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_3 = "E" Then
		Kutu3_Mail =  "ercan.dayan@ozak-t.com, ensar.aktas@ozak-t.com"

		If Trim(MailListX) <> "" Then
			MailListX = MailListX & "," & Kutu3_Mail
		Else
			MailListX = Kutu3_Mail
		End If
	End If

	GetKutuOnayliMailler = MailListX
End Function

Sub cmd_OnaylarIptal
	If Not OzelHakVarMi("TOÝ") Then
		msgbox "Tüm Onaylar Ýptal Etmek için Yetkiniz Yok." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Kullanýcý Tanýmlarý / Kullanýcý Tanýmlý Modül Haklarý Sekmesi" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Özel Yetki Kodu : [ TOÝ ]"

		Exit Sub
	End If

	KutuOnaylari = ""
	ButonOnaylari = ""

	Set S40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")
	Set ZUS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_STOK40E")

	KutuOnaylari = ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK
	ButonOnaylari = S40E.ONAY

	If S40E.ONAY <> "E" and ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK  = "H" Then
		msgbox "Ýptal Edilecek Onay Bulunamadý."

		Exit Sub
	End If

	k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Tüm Onaylar Ýptal Edilecek ve Evrak Kaydedilecek, emin misiniz?", "Dikkat", MB_YESNO)
	If k <> 6 Then Exit Sub

	'ÝPTAL ÖNCESÝ ONAYLAR

	KUTUONAY_1 = ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_1
	KUTUONAY_2 = ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_2
	KUTUONAY_3 = ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_3

	ONAYKULLANICI_1 = ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1
	ONAYTARIH_1 = ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_1
	ONAYSAAT_1 = ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_1

	ONAYKULLANICI_2 = ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_2
	ONAYTARIH_2 = ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_2
	ONAYSAAT_2 = ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_2

	ONAYKULLANICI_3 = ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_3
	ONAYTARIH_3 = ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_3
	ONAYSAAT_3 = ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_3

	ONAYKULLANICI_4 = ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_4
	ONAYTARIH_4 = ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_4
	ONAYSAAT_4 = ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_4


	If S40E.TARIH > "2025/12/09" Then
		S40E.ONAY = "H"
	End If

	For i = 1 To 3
		ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1, "H"

		ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_" & i, 1, ""
		ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_" & i, 1, ""
		ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_" & i, 1, ""
		
		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","KUTU_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 0
		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAYGRUPOK", "READONLY", 0
		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 0

		If i = 3 Then	
			ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_4", 1, ""
			ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_4", 1, ""
			ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_4", 1, ""
			
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAYGRUPOK", "READONLY", 0
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "READONLY", 1
		End If
	Next

	ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK  = "H"
	ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_1 = "E"
	Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","KUTU_ONAY_1", "READONLY", 1

	nret=Doc.Save_Voucher

	Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls

	If nret <> 0 Then
		S40E.ONAY = "E"
		ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK  = "E"

		msgbox "Evrak Kaydedilemedi."

		For i = 1 To 3
			If i=1 Then 
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1, KUTUONAY_1 
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_" & i, 1, ONAYKULLANICI_1
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_" & i, 1, ONAYTARIH_1
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_" & i, 1, ONAYSAAT_1
			End If

			If i=2 Then 
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1, KUTUONAY_2
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_" & i, 1, ONAYKULLANICI_2
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_" & i, 1, ONAYTARIH_2
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_" & i, 1, ONAYSAAT_2
			End If
	
			If i=3 Then 

				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1, KUTUONAY_3 
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_" & i, 1, ONAYKULLANICI_3
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_" & i, 1, ONAYTARIH_3
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_" & i, 1, ONAYSAAT_3

				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_KULLANICI_4", 1, ONAYKULLANICI_4
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_TARIH_4", 1, ONAYTARIH_4
				ZUS40E.SetFieldValue "ONAY_SAAT_4", 1, ONAYSAAT_4

				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4" , "READONLY", 1
			End If

			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","KUTU_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 1
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAYGRUPOK", "READONLY", 1
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 1
		Next

		Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls

		Exit Sub
	End If

	'**************** email at *******************************
	MailList = ""

	If KutuOnaylari = "E" and ButonOnaylari = "E" Then
		MailList1 = GetKutuOnayliMailler
		MailList2 = GetButonOnayMailler
		MailList = MailList1 & ", " & MailList2
	ElseIf KutuOnaylari = "E" Then
		MailList = GetKutuOnayliMailler
	End If

	If MailList <> "" Then
		MailKonusu = "[ " & Trim(ZUS40E.EVRAKNO) & " ] No' lu Satýþ Sipariþ Onay Süreci [ " & Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName) & " ] Kullanýcýsý Tarafýndan Ýptal Edilmiþtir.(TIE))" 

		Call SendEkliPdfMail(MailKonusu, MailList)	
	End If
		
	Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------
Function GetMailList(MailStrVal)
	SQL = "SELECT STRING_AGG(TRIM(EMAIL), ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EMAIL) AS MAIL_LIST "
	SQL = SQL & "FROM UDEF "
	SQL = SQL & "WHERE KOD IN "
	SQL = SQL & "  ( SELECT KOD FROM UDEFT12 WHERE OZEL_HAK_KODU IN (" & MailStrVal & ") "
	SQL = SQL & "  ) "
	SQL = SQL & "AND TRIM(EMAIL) IS NOT NULL"

	Set MAILTABLE = Doc.RunSQLQuery("AtTTANBB", SQL)
	
	If MAILTABLE.GetRecCount > 0 Then
	    GetMailList = MAILTABLE.MAIL_LIST(1)
	Else
	    GetMailList = ""
	End If
End Function

Sub cmd_OnayGrubuSecimOK
	Set S40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")

	OzelYetkiKodu = "STS_OGRUP"

	If Not OzelHakVarMi(OzelYetkiKodu) Then
		msgbox "Kullanýcý Tanýmlarýnda Yetkiniz Tanýmlanmamýþ. " & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Özel Yetki Kodu : [ " & OzelYetkiKodu &  " ]"

		Exit Sub
	End If

	Set ZUS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_STOK40E")

	k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Ayarlar kaydedilecek ve ilgili kiþilere e-mail atýlacak,  emin misiniz?", "Uyarý", MB_YESNO)
	If k <> 6 Then Exit Sub

	ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK = "E"

	nret = Doc.Save_Voucher
	
	If nret <> 0 Then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox("Evrak Kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir", "Uyarý", MB_OK)

		ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK = "H"

		Exit Sub
	End If

	If nret = 0 Then
		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAYGRUPOK", "READONLY", 1

		For i = 2 To 3
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","KUTU_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 1
		Next
	End If

	Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls

	'**************** email at *******************************

	MailList = ""

	MailList = GetKutuOnayliMailler

	If MailList <> "" Then
		MailKonusu = "[ " & Trim(ZUS40E.EVRAKNO) & " ] No' lu Satýþ Sipariþi Açýlmýþ ve Tarafýnýza Onay Yetkisi Tanýmlanmýþtýr.(OYT)" 

		Call SendEkliPdfMail(MailKonusu, MailList)	
	End If
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------
Function OzelHakVarMi(HakKodu)
	OzelHakVarMi = False
	Set U12 = Doc.Select1("de443d44t", "UDEFT12", "KOD='" & Doc.Getd7UserName() & "'&OZEL_HAK_KODU='" & HakKodu & "'", "", -1)
	If U12.GetRowCount() > 0 Then OzelHakVarMi = True
End Function

Sub OnayYetkiKontrol
	Set S40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")
	Set ZUS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_STOK40E")

	For i = 1 To 3
		If i=3 Then
			If ZUS40E.GetFieldValue("KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1) = "E" Then
				If Trim(ZUS40E.GetFieldValue("ONAY_KULLANICI_3", 1)) = "" Then  
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "BCKCOL", "YELLOW"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				Else
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "BCKCOL", "GREEN"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				End If

				'YGS PROJE
				If Trim(ZUS40E.GetFieldValue("ONAY_KULLANICI_4", 1)) = "" Then  
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "BCKCOL", "YELLOW"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				Else
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "BCKCOL", "GREEN"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				End If
			Else
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "BCKCOL", "GRAY"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3", "TXTCOL", "WHITE"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_3" , "READONLY", 1

				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "BCKCOL", "GRAY"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "TXTCOL", "WHITE"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_4", "READONLY", 1
			End If

		Else
			If ZUS40E.GetFieldValue("KUTU_ONAY_" & i, 1) = "E" Then
				If Trim(ZUS40E.GetFieldValue("ONAY_KULLANICI_" & i, 1)) = "" Then  
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "BCKCOL", "YELLOW"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				Else
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "BCKCOL", "GREEN"
					Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "TXTCOL", "BLACK"
				End If
			Else
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "BCKCOL", "GRAY"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "TXTCOL", "WHITE"
				Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 1
			End If
		End If
	Next

	Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls
End Sub

Sub cmd_Onay1
	SetS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK40E")
	Set ZUS40E = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_STOK40E")
	KullaniciVal = Doc.Getd7UserName
	OzelYetkiKodu = "STS_ONAY1"

	If Not OzelHakVarMi(OzelYetkiKodu) Then
		msgbox "Kullanýcý Tanýmlarýnda ( Planlama ) için Onay Verme Yetkiniz Tanýmlanmamýþ. " & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Özel Yetki Kodu : [ " & OzelYetkiKodu &  " ]"

		Exit Sub
	End If

	If ZUS40E.ONAYGRUPOK <> "E" Then
		Msgbox "Önce Onay için Ürün Grubu Seçimini Sonlandýrýn."

		Exit Sub
	End If

	' ***************** önceki onaylar tamamlanmýþ mý kontrolü ************
	OncekiOnaylar = True
	msg = ""

	If ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_2 = "E" Then
		If Trim(ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_2) = "" Then
			msg = "AGS Onayý Verilmeli."
			OncekiOnaylar = False
		End If
	End If

	If ZUS40E.KUTU_ONAY_3 = "E" Then
		If Trim(ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_3) = "" Then
			OncekiOnaylar = False
			If trim(msg) <> "" Then 
				msg = msg & vbcrlf & "YGS Onayý Verilmeli."
			Else
				msg = "YGS Onayý Verilmeli."
			End If
		End If

		If Trim(ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_4) = "" Then
			OncekiOnaylar = False

			If trim(msg) <> "" Then 
				msg = msg & vbcrlf & "YGS Proje Onayý Verilmeli."
			Else
				msg = "YGS Proje Onayý Verilmeli."
			End If
		End If
	End If
	
	If Not OncekiOnaylar Then
		msgbox "Önce Aþaðýdaki Onay/lar Verilmelidir." & vbcrlf & "---------------------------------------" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & msg
	
		Exit Sub
	End If 

	'*********************************************************************
	If Trim(ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1) = "" Then
		ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1 = KullaniciVal
		ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_1 = Doc.Bugun
		ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_1 = Doc.Saat(5)
	Else
		ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_1 = ""
	End If
	
	'**************** email at *******************************
	k=Doc.d7MsgBox("Evrakda Gerekli Onaylar Tamamlanmýþ." & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Onay Süreci Tamamlansýn mý?", "Uyarý", MB_YESNO)
	
	If k=vbYes Then
		S40E.ONAY = "E" 
	
		For i = 1 To 4
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 1
		Next
	Else
		S40E.ONAY = "H" 

		ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_1 = ""

		Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_1", "READONLY", 0

		Exit Sub
	End If

	Call OnayYetkiKontrol

	nret = Doc.Save_Voucher
	
	If nret <> 0 Then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox("Evrak Kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir", "Uyarý", MB_OK)

		S40E.ONAY = "H" 

		ZUS40E.ONAY_KULLANICI_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_TARIH_1 = ""
		ZUS40E.ONAY_SAAT_1 = ""

		For i = 1 To 4
			Doc.SetFormControlProperty "","BTN_ONAY_" & i, "READONLY", 0
		Next

		Call OnayYetkiKontrol

		Exit Sub
	End If

	Call OnayYetkiKontrol

	Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls

	'********************** MAÝL AT ****************************
	
	MailList = ""

	MailList = GetButonOnayMailler

	If MailList <> "" Then
		MailKonusu = "[ " & Trim(ZUS40E.EVRAKNO) & " ] No' lu Satýþ Sipariþine Ait Onay Süreci Tamamlanmýþtýr.(OST)"

		Call SendEkliPdfMail(MailKonusu, MailList)	
	End If
End Sub

Makro Kodu Sekmesi : 

Sub TalepOlustur1()
	
	Dim Doc1
	Dim ST47E
	Dim ST47T
	Dim Rec_Count
	Dim S47
	Dim rec
	Set S47=Doc.Select2("sadfsdf","STOK47T","SELECTED='E'&ACIKKAPALI<>'K'","",-1)
	Set S47T=Doc.GetTableObject("STOK47T")
	Rec_Count=S47T.GetRecCount
	If S47.GetRecCount>0 Then
		q1=Doc.D7MsgBox ("Seçili satýrlar için yeni talep oluþturulsun mu?","dinamo ERP", MB_YESNO+MB_ICONQUESTION)
		If q1=6 Then	
			Set Doc1=Doc.CreateDocumentNOUI("STOK47","")
			Set ST47E=Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK47E")
			Set ST47T=Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK47T")
			rec=Doc1.New_Voucher()
			ST47E.CODEDBOLUM="DEPO"
			ST47E.CODEDKISI="0000000000000027"
			For i= 1 To Rec_Count
				If Trim(S47T.SELECTED(i))="E" and Trim(S47T.ACIKKAPALI(i))<>"K"  Then
					satir=ST47T.Addrow()
					ST47T.SetCurrentRow(satir)
					ST47T.KOD(satir)=S47T.KOD(i)
					ST47T.SF_MIKTAR(satir)=S47T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
					ST47T.SF_SF_UNIT(satir)=S47T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
					ST47T.RTALEPEDILENTESTARIH(satir)=S47T.RTALEPEDILENTESTARIH(i)
					ST47T.REFTEXT01(satir)=Trim(S47T.EVRAKNO)
				End If	
			Next
			rec=Doc1.Save_Voucher()
			If rec=0 then
				For i= 1 To S47T.getRecCount
					If Trim(S47T.SELECTED(i))="E"  Then
						S47T.ACIKKAPALI(i)="K"			
					End If
				Next
				rec=doc1.Loadempty_voucher
				set doc1=nothing
				e_rec=Doc.Save_Voucher	
			End If
		Else
			Exit sub		
		End If
	End If

End Sub


Sub TalepOlustur()
	Doc.RunMacro0 "MAKR7S.STOK47","Makro1"
End Sub

Makro Kodu Sekmesi : 

Sub TalepOlustur1()
	
	Dim Doc1
	Dim ST47E
	Dim ST47T
	Dim Rec_Count
	Dim S47
	Dim rec
	Set S47=Doc.Select2("sadfsdf","STOK47T","SELECTED='E'&ACIKKAPALI<>'K'","",-1)
	Set S47T=Doc.GetTableObject("STOK47T")
	Rec_Count=S47T.GetRecCount
	If S47.GetRecCount>0 Then
		q1=Doc.D7MsgBox ("Seçili satýrlar için yeni talep oluþturulsun mu?","dinamo ERP", MB_YESNO+MB_ICONQUESTION)
		If q1=6 Then	
			Set Doc1=Doc.CreateDocumentNOUI("STOK47","")
			Set ST47E=Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK47E")
			Set ST47T=Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK47T")
			rec=Doc1.New_Voucher()
			ST47E.CODEDBOLUM="DEPO"
			ST47E.CODEDKISI="0000000000000027"
			For i= 1 To Rec_Count
				If Trim(S47T.SELECTED(i))="E" and Trim(S47T.ACIKKAPALI(i))<>"K"  Then
					satir=ST47T.Addrow()
					ST47T.SetCurrentRow(satir)
					ST47T.KOD(satir)=S47T.KOD(i)
					ST47T.SF_MIKTAR(satir)=S47T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
					ST47T.SF_SF_UNIT(satir)=S47T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
					ST47T.RTALEPEDILENTESTARIH(satir)=S47T.RTALEPEDILENTESTARIH(i)
					ST47T.REFTEXT01(satir)=Trim(S47T.EVRAKNO)
				End If	
			Next
			rec=Doc1.Save_Voucher()
			If rec=0 then
				For i= 1 To S47T.getRecCount
					If Trim(S47T.SELECTED(i))="E"  Then
						S47T.ACIKKAPALI(i)="K"			
					End If
				Next
				rec=doc1.Loadempty_voucher
				set doc1=nothing
				e_rec=Doc.Save_Voucher	
			End If
		Else
			Exit sub		
		End If
	End If

End Sub


Sub TalepOlustur()
	Doc.RunMacro0 "MAKR7S.STOK47","Makro1"
End Sub

Makro Kodu Sekmesi : 

Sub TalepOlustur1()
	
	Dim Doc1
	Dim ST47E
	Dim ST47T
	Dim Rec_Count
	Dim S47
	Dim rec
	Set S47=Doc.Select2("sadfsdf","STOK47T","SELECTED='E'&ACIKKAPALI<>'K'","",-1)
	Set S47T=Doc.GetTableObject("STOK47T")
	Rec_Count=S47T.GetRecCount
	If S47.GetRecCount>0 Then
		q1=Doc.D7MsgBox ("Seçili satýrlar için yeni talep oluþturulsun mu?","dinamo ERP", MB_YESNO+MB_ICONQUESTION)
		If q1=6 Then	
			Set Doc1=Doc.CreateDocumentNOUI("STOK47","")
			Set ST47E=Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK47E")
			Set ST47T=Doc1.GetTableObject("STOK47T")
			rec=Doc1.New_Voucher()
			ST47E.CODEDBOLUM="DEPO"
			ST47E.CODEDKISI="0000000000000027"
			For i= 1 To Rec_Count
				If Trim(S47T.SELECTED(i))="E" and Trim(S47T.ACIKKAPALI(i))<>"K"  Then
					satir=ST47T.Addrow()
					ST47T.SetCurrentRow(satir)
					ST47T.KOD(satir)=S47T.KOD(i)
					ST47T.SF_MIKTAR(satir)=S47T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
					ST47T.SF_SF_UNIT(satir)=S47T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
					ST47T.RTALEPEDILENTESTARIH(satir)=S47T.RTALEPEDILENTESTARIH(i)
					ST47T.REFTEXT01(satir)=Trim(S47T.EVRAKNO)
				End If	
			Next
			rec=Doc1.Save_Voucher()
			If rec=0 then
				For i= 1 To S47T.getRecCount
					If Trim(S47T.SELECTED(i))="E"  Then
						S47T.ACIKKAPALI(i)="K"			
					End If
				Next
				rec=doc1.Loadempty_voucher
				set doc1=nothing
				e_rec=Doc.Save_Voucher	
			End If
		Else
			Exit sub		
		End If
	End If

End Sub


Sub TalepOlustur()
	Doc.RunMacro0 "MAKR7S.STOK47","Makro1"
End Sub

Makro Kodu Sekmesi : 

Sub cmd_yenidenhesapla
	Set S68E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK68E")
	
	If Trim(S68E.GK_1) <> "LAZER" Then
		msgbox "Sadece GK-1 'de LAZER Tanýmlý Evraklar için Çalýþýr."

		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	Call FasonHammaddeMasraflariniHesapla
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function StokKartindaTanimliMi(FasonGelenStokKoduVal, TuketilenStokKodu, ZUS00)
	StokKartindaTanimliMi = False

	If Trim(TuketilenStokKodu) = "" Then
		Set ZUS00 = Doc.Select1("ZU_STOK00_DB", "ZU_STOK00", "MIKTAR > 0 & KOD = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' ", "", -1)
	
		If ZUS00.GetRecCount > 0 Then
			StokKartindaTanimliMi = True
		End If
	Else
		Set ZUS00 = Doc.Select1("ZU_STOK00_DB", "ZU_STOK00", "HMSTKKOD = '"& TuketilenStokKodu &"' & MIKTAR > 0 & KOD = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' ", "", -1)
	
		If ZUS00.GetRecCount > 0 Then
			StokKartindaTanimliMi = True
		End If
	End If
End Function
'-------------------------------------------------------------
Function UrunAgacindaTanimliMi(FasonGelenStokKoduVal, TuketilenStokKodu, EvrakNo, B01T)
	UrunAgacindaTanimliMi = False

	If Trim(TuketilenStokKodu) = "" Then
		Set B01T = Doc.Select1("BOMU01T_DB3", "BOMU01T", "BOMREC_KAYNAK0 > 0 & AKTIF_PASIF = '*' & BOMREC_CODE = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' & BOMREC_INPUTTYPE='H' ", "", -1)

		If B01T.GetRecCount > 0 Then
			UrunAgacindaTanimliMi = True
			EvrakNo = Trim(B01T.EVRAKNO(1))
		Else
			Set B01T = Doc.Select1("BOMU01T_DB4", "BOMU01T", "BOMREC_KAYNAK0 > 0 & BOMREC_CODE = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' & BOMREC_INPUTTYPE='H' ", "", -1)
	
			If B01T.GetRecCount > 0 Then
				UrunAgacindaTanimliMi = True
				EvrakNo = Trim(B01T.EVRAKNO(1))
			End If
		End If

	Else

		Set B01T = Doc.Select1("BOMU01T_DB", "BOMU01T", "BOMREC_KAYNAK0 > 0 & AKTIF_PASIF = '*' & BOMREC_CODE = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' &  BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE = '"& TuketilenStokKodu &"' & BOMREC_INPUTTYPE='H' ", "", -1)
	
		If B01T.GetRecCount > 0 Then
			UrunAgacindaTanimliMi = True
			EvrakNo = Trim(B01T.EVRAKNO(1))
		Else
			Set B01T = Doc.Select1("BOMU01T_DB2", "BOMU01T", "BOMREC_KAYNAK0 > 0 & BOMREC_CODE = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' &  BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE = '"& TuketilenStokKodu &"' & BOMREC_INPUTTYPE='H' ", "", -1)
	
			If B01T.GetRecCount > 0 Then
				UrunAgacindaTanimliMi = True
				EvrakNo = Trim(B01T.EVRAKNO(1))
			End If
		End If
	End If
End Function
'-------------------------------------------------------------
Sub FasonHammaddeMasraflariniHesapla
	TanimsizUyariVer = False

	Set FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET = Doc.GetTableObject("FRM_STACK_MAKROTABLET")
	FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.Empty

	Set S68E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK68E")
	TarihVal = S68E.TARIH

	Set S68T=Doc.GetTableObject("STOK68T")

	For i = 1 To S68T.GetRecCount
		S68T.REFTEXT04(i) = ""

		FasonGelen_StokKoduVal = S68T.KOD(i)
		FasonGelen_StokAdiVal = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", S68T.KOD(i), "")
		FasonGelen_MiktarVal = S68T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		FasonGelen_StokBirimiVal = S68T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
		FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo = S68T.REFTEXT02(i)

		If Trim(FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo) <> "" Then

			Set S68TSTACK = Doc.Select2G("S68T_STACK", "STOK68T", "KOD='"& FasonGelen_StokKoduVal &"' & REFTEXT02 = '"& FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo &"' ", "", "KOD+REFTEXT02", -1)
			Set S68TSTACKTOTAL = Doc.Select2G("S68T_STACK2", "STOK68T", "REFTEXT02 = '"& FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo &"' ", "", "REFTEXT02", -1)

			ToplamFasondanGelenMiktar = S68TSTACKTOTAL.SF_MIKTAR(1)

			'Set S63DB = Doc.Select1G("STOK63_DB", "STOK63T", "REFTEXT01 = '"& FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo &"' ", "", "KOD+REFTEXT01", -1)
	
			sql = " SELECT EVRAKNO, KOD, REFTEXT01, SUM(SF_MIKTAR) SF_MIKTAR  "
			sql  = sql & " FROM STOK63T "
			sql  = sql & " WHERE REFTEXT01 = '"& FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo &"' "
			
			sql  = sql & " GROUP BY EVRAKNO, KOD, REFTEXT01 "
			
			Set S63DB = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dde34r55", sql)
			
			If S63DB.GetRecCount = 0 Then
				'geçen yýla bak

				sql = " SELECT EVRAKNO, KOD, REFTEXT01, SUM(SF_MIKTAR) SF_MIKTAR  "
				sql  = sql & " FROM " & dbYil & ".dbo.STOK63T "
				sql  = sql & " WHERE REFTEXT01 = '"& FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo &"' "
				
				sql  = sql & " GROUP BY EVRAKNO, KOD, REFTEXT01 "
				
				Set S63DB = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dde34r55", sql)
			End If	

			If S63DB.GetRecCount > 0 Then
				For j = 1 To S63DB.GetRecCount
					FasonCikis_EvrakNoVal = Trim(S63DB.EVRAKNO(j))
					FasonCikis_TuketilenStokKodu = S63DB.KOD(j) 
					FasonCikis_TuketilenStokAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", FasonCikis_TuketilenStokKodu, "")
					FasonCikis_TuketilenStokBirimi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", FasonCikis_TuketilenStokKodu, "")
	
					FasonCikis_ToplamTuketimMiktari = S63DB.SF_MIKTAR(j)
	
					OranVal = Doc.Div(FasonCikis_ToplamTuketimMiktari, ToplamFasondanGelenMiktar)
	
					FasonGelen_IcinTuketimPayi = OranVal * FasonGelen_MiktarVal
					
					SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray = Doc.SonSatinalma(FasonCikis_TuketilenStokKodu, TarihVal)
			
					If IsArray(SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray) Then
						SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati = SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray(2)
					End If

					SatirNo = FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.AddRow
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.SetCurrentRow SatirNo

					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.ACIKLAMA = "STOK63T- ( " & Trim(FasonCikis_EvrakNoVal) & " )"
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_KOD = FasonGelen_StokKoduVal
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_AD = FasonGelen_StokAdiVal
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_SF_MIKTAR = FasonGelen_MiktarVal
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_BIRIM = FasonGelen_StokBirimiVal
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO = FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo

					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_KOD = FasonCikis_TuketilenStokKodu
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_AD = FasonCikis_TuketilenStokAdi
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM_MIKTAR = OranVal

If Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName) = "BT" Then
'msgbox OranVal
End If
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TOPLAM_MIKTAR = FasonGelen_IcinTuketimPayi
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM = FasonCikis_TuketilenStokBirimi
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_LAZERKESIMNO = FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo

					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_FIYAT = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_REFTARIH = TarihVal
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati * FasonGelen_IcinTuketimPayi
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_TL_BIRIMMALIYET = Doc.Div(FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR, FasonGelen_MiktarVal) 
				Next
			Else
				'tanýmlý kesim noya göre fason çýkýþ fiþi yok 
 
				SatirNo = FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.AddRow
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.SetCurrentRow SatirNo
	
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_KOD = FasonGelen_StokKoduVal
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_AD = FasonGelen_StokAdiVal
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_SF_MIKTAR = FasonGelen_MiktarVal
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_BIRIM = FasonGelen_StokBirimiVal
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO = FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo
	
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.ACIKLAMA = "FASON ÇIKIÞ FÝÞÝ YOK"
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_LAZERKESIMNO = "FASON ÇIKIÞ FÝÞÝ YOK"
	
				'***** ürün aðacýnda tüketilen tanýmlý mý kontrolü *************
				If UrunAgacindaTanimliMi(FasonGelen_StokKoduVal, "", EvrakNo, B01T) Then
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.ACIKLAMA = "FASON ÇIKIÞ FÝÞÝ YOK - BOMU01T - ( " & Trim(EvrakNo) & " )"
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_LAZERKESIMNO = "ÜRÜN AÐACINDAN"
	
					If B01T.GetRecCount > 0 Then
	
						For x = 1 To B01T.GetRecCount 
	
							If x > 1 Then
								SatirNo = FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.AddRow
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.SetCurrentRow SatirNo
					
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_KOD = FasonGelen_StokKoduVal
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_AD = FasonGelen_StokAdiVal
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_SF_MIKTAR = FasonGelen_MiktarVal
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_BIRIM = FasonGelen_StokBirimiVal
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO = FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo
							End If
	
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_KOD = B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(x)
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_AD = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(x), "")
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(x), "")
			
							SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray = Doc.SonSatinalma(B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(x), TarihVal)
					
							If IsArray(SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray) Then
								SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati = SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray(2)
							End If
			
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_FIYAT = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_REFTARIH = TarihVal
	
							UrunAgaci_BirimUretilenAdetIcinTuketilenMiktar = Doc.Div(B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(x), B01T.BOMREC_MAMULMIKTAR(x))
		
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM_MIKTAR = UrunAgaci_BirimUretilenAdetIcinTuketilenMiktar
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TOPLAM_MIKTAR = UrunAgaci_BirimUretilenAdetIcinTuketilenMiktar * FasonGelen_MiktarVal

							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati * UrunAgaci_BirimUretilenAdetIcinTuketilenMiktar * FasonGelen_MiktarVal
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_TL_BIRIMMALIYET = Doc.Div(FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR, FasonGelen_MiktarVal) 

						Next
					End If
				Else

					'***** ürün aðacýnda tüketilen tanýmlý deðil ise stok kartýnda tanýmlý mý kontrolü *************

					If StokKartindaTanimliMi(FasonGelen_StokKoduVal, "", ZUS00) Then
						FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.ACIKLAMA = "FASON ÇIKIÞ FÝÞÝ YOK - STOK00 - ( " & Trim(FasonGelen_StokKoduVal) & " )"
						FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_LAZERKESIMNO = "STOK KARTINDAN"
	
						If ZUS00.GetRecCount > 0 Then
							For x = 1 To ZUS00.GetRecCount 	
	
								If x > 1 Then
									SatirNo = FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.AddRow
									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.SetCurrentRow SatirNo

									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_KOD = FasonGelen_StokKoduVal
									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_AD = FasonGelen_StokAdiVal
									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_SF_MIKTAR = FasonGelen_MiktarVal
									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_BIRIM = FasonGelen_StokBirimiVal
									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO = FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo
								End If
								
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_KOD = ZUS00.HMSTKKOD(x)
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_AD = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", ZUS00.HMSTKKOD(x), "")
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", ZUS00.HMSTKKOD(x), "")
				
								SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray = Doc.SonSatinalma(ZUS00.HMSTKKOD(x), TarihVal)
						
								If IsArray(SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray) Then
									SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati = SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray(2)
								End If
				
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_FIYAT = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_REFTARIH = TarihVal
	
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM_MIKTAR = ZUS00.MIKTAR(x)
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TOPLAM_MIKTAR = ZUS00.MIKTAR(x) * FasonGelen_MiktarVal

								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati * ZUS00.MIKTAR(x) * FasonGelen_MiktarVal
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_TL_BIRIMMALIYET = Doc.Div(FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR, FasonGelen_MiktarVal) 

							Next
						End If
	
					Else
						FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.ACIKLAMA = "TANIMSIZ"
						FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_LAZERKESIMNO = "TANIMSIZ"

						TanimsizUyariVer = True
					End If
				End If
			End If

			Set S63DB = Nothing

		End If
	Next
	
	'*************************************

	For j = 1 To  S68T.GetRecCount

		S68T.MASRAFPAYIFIYATM(j) = 0

		Set FRMSTACKMAKROTABLETSTACK2 = Doc.Select2G("FRM_STACK_MAKROTABLET_STACK2", "FRM_STACK_MAKROTABLET", "FASONGELEN_KOD = '"& S68T.KOD(j) &"' & FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO = '"& S68T.REFTEXT02(j)  &"' ", "", "FASONGELEN_KOD+FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO", -1)
	
		If FRMSTACKMAKROTABLETSTACK2.GetRecCount > 0 Then

			BirimUrunTLMaliyet = FRMSTACKMAKROTABLETSTACK2.FASONGELEN_TL_BIRIMMALIYET(1)
			
			S68T.MASRAFPAYIFIYATM(j) = BirimUrunTLMaliyet
			S68T.MASRAFPAYITUTARM(j) = BirimUrunTLMaliyet * S68T.SF_MIKTAR(j)
		End If

		Set FRMSTACKMAKROTABLETSTACK2 = Nothing
	Next

	If TanimsizUyariVer Then
		msgbox "[Daðýtýlacak Maliyetler] Sekmesindeki " & vbcrlf & "Sac Tüketim Maliyet Tablosunda Tanýmsýz Satýr/lar Var. Kontrol Ediniz."
	End If
End Sub
