Makro Kodu Sekmesi : 

Sub cmd_yenidenhesapla
	Set S68E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK68E")
	
	If Trim(S68E.GK_1) <> "LAZER" Then
		msgbox "Sadece GK-1 'de LAZER Tanýmlý Evraklar için Çalýþýr."

		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	Call FasonHammaddeMasraflariniHesapla
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function StokKartindaTanimliMi(FasonGelenStokKoduVal, TuketilenStokKodu, ZUS00)
	StokKartindaTanimliMi = False

	If Trim(TuketilenStokKodu) = "" Then
		Set ZUS00 = Doc.Select1("ZU_STOK00_DB", "ZU_STOK00", "MIKTAR > 0 & KOD = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' ", "", -1)
	
		If ZUS00.GetRecCount > 0 Then
			StokKartindaTanimliMi = True
		End If
	Else
		Set ZUS00 = Doc.Select1("ZU_STOK00_DB", "ZU_STOK00", "HMSTKKOD = '"& TuketilenStokKodu &"' & MIKTAR > 0 & KOD = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' ", "", -1)
	
		If ZUS00.GetRecCount > 0 Then
			StokKartindaTanimliMi = True
		End If
	End If
End Function
'-------------------------------------------------------------
Function UrunAgacindaTanimliMi(FasonGelenStokKoduVal, TuketilenStokKodu, EvrakNo, B01T)
	UrunAgacindaTanimliMi = False

	If Trim(TuketilenStokKodu) = "" Then
		Set B01T = Doc.Select1("BOMU01T_DB3", "BOMU01T", "BOMREC_KAYNAK0 > 0 & AKTIF_PASIF = '*' & BOMREC_CODE = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' & BOMREC_INPUTTYPE='H' ", "", -1)

		If B01T.GetRecCount > 0 Then
			UrunAgacindaTanimliMi = True
			EvrakNo = Trim(B01T.EVRAKNO(1))
		Else
			Set B01T = Doc.Select1("BOMU01T_DB4", "BOMU01T", "BOMREC_KAYNAK0 > 0 & BOMREC_CODE = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' & BOMREC_INPUTTYPE='H' ", "", -1)
	
			If B01T.GetRecCount > 0 Then
				UrunAgacindaTanimliMi = True
				EvrakNo = Trim(B01T.EVRAKNO(1))
			End If
		End If

	Else

		Set B01T = Doc.Select1("BOMU01T_DB", "BOMU01T", "BOMREC_KAYNAK0 > 0 & AKTIF_PASIF = '*' & BOMREC_CODE = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' &  BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE = '"& TuketilenStokKodu &"' & BOMREC_INPUTTYPE='H' ", "", -1)
	
		If B01T.GetRecCount > 0 Then
			UrunAgacindaTanimliMi = True
			EvrakNo = Trim(B01T.EVRAKNO(1))
		Else
			Set B01T = Doc.Select1("BOMU01T_DB2", "BOMU01T", "BOMREC_KAYNAK0 > 0 & BOMREC_CODE = '"& FasonGelenStokKoduVal &"' &  BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE = '"& TuketilenStokKodu &"' & BOMREC_INPUTTYPE='H' ", "", -1)
	
			If B01T.GetRecCount > 0 Then
				UrunAgacindaTanimliMi = True
				EvrakNo = Trim(B01T.EVRAKNO(1))
			End If
		End If
	End If
End Function
'-------------------------------------------------------------
Sub FasonHammaddeMasraflariniHesapla
	TanimsizUyariVer = False

	Set FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET = Doc.GetTableObject("FRM_STACK_MAKROTABLET")
	FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.Empty

	Set S68E = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK68E")
	TarihVal = S68E.TARIH

	Set S68T=Doc.GetTableObject("STOK68T")

	For i = 1 To S68T.GetRecCount
		S68T.REFTEXT04(i) = ""

		FasonGelen_StokKoduVal = S68T.KOD(i)
		FasonGelen_StokAdiVal = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", S68T.KOD(i), "")
		FasonGelen_MiktarVal = S68T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		FasonGelen_StokBirimiVal = S68T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
		FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo = S68T.REFTEXT02(i)

		If Trim(FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo) <> "" Then

			Set S68TSTACK = Doc.Select2G("S68T_STACK", "STOK68T", "KOD='"& FasonGelen_StokKoduVal &"' & REFTEXT02 = '"& FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo &"' ", "", "KOD+REFTEXT02", -1)
			Set S68TSTACKTOTAL = Doc.Select2G("S68T_STACK2", "STOK68T", "REFTEXT02 = '"& FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo &"' ", "", "REFTEXT02", -1)

			ToplamFasondanGelenMiktar = S68TSTACKTOTAL.SF_MIKTAR(1)

			'Set S63DB = Doc.Select1G("STOK63_DB", "STOK63T", "REFTEXT01 = '"& FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo &"' ", "", "KOD+REFTEXT01", -1)
	
			sql = " SELECT EVRAKNO, KOD, REFTEXT01, SUM(SF_MIKTAR) SF_MIKTAR  "
			sql  = sql & " FROM STOK63T "
			sql  = sql & " WHERE REFTEXT01 = '"& FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo &"' "
			
			sql  = sql & " GROUP BY EVRAKNO, KOD, REFTEXT01 "
			
			Set S63DB = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dde34r55", sql)
			
			If S63DB.GetRecCount = 0 Then
				'geçen yýla bak

				sql = " SELECT EVRAKNO, KOD, REFTEXT01, SUM(SF_MIKTAR) SF_MIKTAR  "
				sql  = sql & " FROM " & dbYil & ".dbo.STOK63T "
				sql  = sql & " WHERE REFTEXT01 = '"& FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo &"' "
				
				sql  = sql & " GROUP BY EVRAKNO, KOD, REFTEXT01 "
				
				Set S63DB = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dde34r55", sql)
			End If	

			If S63DB.GetRecCount > 0 Then
				For j = 1 To S63DB.GetRecCount
					FasonCikis_EvrakNoVal = Trim(S63DB.EVRAKNO(j))
					FasonCikis_TuketilenStokKodu = S63DB.KOD(j) 
					FasonCikis_TuketilenStokAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", FasonCikis_TuketilenStokKodu, "")
					FasonCikis_TuketilenStokBirimi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", FasonCikis_TuketilenStokKodu, "")
	
					FasonCikis_ToplamTuketimMiktari = S63DB.SF_MIKTAR(j)
	
					OranVal = Doc.Div(FasonCikis_ToplamTuketimMiktari, ToplamFasondanGelenMiktar)
	
					FasonGelen_IcinTuketimPayi = OranVal * FasonGelen_MiktarVal
					
					SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray = Doc.SonSatinalma(FasonCikis_TuketilenStokKodu, TarihVal)
			
					If IsArray(SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray) Then
						SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati = SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray(2)
					End If

					SatirNo = FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.AddRow
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.SetCurrentRow SatirNo

					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.ACIKLAMA = "STOK63T- ( " & Trim(FasonCikis_EvrakNoVal) & " )"
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_KOD = FasonGelen_StokKoduVal
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_AD = FasonGelen_StokAdiVal
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_SF_MIKTAR = FasonGelen_MiktarVal
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_BIRIM = FasonGelen_StokBirimiVal
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO = FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo

					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_KOD = FasonCikis_TuketilenStokKodu
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_AD = FasonCikis_TuketilenStokAdi
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM_MIKTAR = OranVal

If Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName) = "BT" Then
'msgbox OranVal
End If
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TOPLAM_MIKTAR = FasonGelen_IcinTuketimPayi
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM = FasonCikis_TuketilenStokBirimi
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_LAZERKESIMNO = FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo

					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_FIYAT = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_REFTARIH = TarihVal
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati * FasonGelen_IcinTuketimPayi
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_TL_BIRIMMALIYET = Doc.Div(FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR, FasonGelen_MiktarVal) 
				Next
			Else
				'tanýmlý kesim noya göre fason çýkýþ fiþi yok 
 
				SatirNo = FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.AddRow
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.SetCurrentRow SatirNo
	
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_KOD = FasonGelen_StokKoduVal
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_AD = FasonGelen_StokAdiVal
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_SF_MIKTAR = FasonGelen_MiktarVal
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_BIRIM = FasonGelen_StokBirimiVal
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO = FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo
	
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.ACIKLAMA = "FASON ÇIKIÞ FÝÞÝ YOK"
				FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_LAZERKESIMNO = "FASON ÇIKIÞ FÝÞÝ YOK"
	
				'***** ürün aðacýnda tüketilen tanýmlý mý kontrolü *************
				If UrunAgacindaTanimliMi(FasonGelen_StokKoduVal, "", EvrakNo, B01T) Then
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.ACIKLAMA = "FASON ÇIKIÞ FÝÞÝ YOK - BOMU01T - ( " & Trim(EvrakNo) & " )"
					FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_LAZERKESIMNO = "ÜRÜN AÐACINDAN"
	
					If B01T.GetRecCount > 0 Then
	
						For x = 1 To B01T.GetRecCount 
	
							If x > 1 Then
								SatirNo = FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.AddRow
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.SetCurrentRow SatirNo
					
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_KOD = FasonGelen_StokKoduVal
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_AD = FasonGelen_StokAdiVal
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_SF_MIKTAR = FasonGelen_MiktarVal
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_BIRIM = FasonGelen_StokBirimiVal
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO = FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo
							End If
	
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_KOD = B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(x)
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_AD = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(x), "")
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(x), "")
			
							SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray = Doc.SonSatinalma(B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(x), TarihVal)
					
							If IsArray(SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray) Then
								SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati = SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray(2)
							End If
			
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_FIYAT = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_REFTARIH = TarihVal
	
							UrunAgaci_BirimUretilenAdetIcinTuketilenMiktar = Doc.Div(B01T.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(x), B01T.BOMREC_MAMULMIKTAR(x))
		
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM_MIKTAR = UrunAgaci_BirimUretilenAdetIcinTuketilenMiktar
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TOPLAM_MIKTAR = UrunAgaci_BirimUretilenAdetIcinTuketilenMiktar * FasonGelen_MiktarVal

							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati * UrunAgaci_BirimUretilenAdetIcinTuketilenMiktar * FasonGelen_MiktarVal
							FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_TL_BIRIMMALIYET = Doc.Div(FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR, FasonGelen_MiktarVal) 

						Next
					End If
				Else

					'***** ürün aðacýnda tüketilen tanýmlý deðil ise stok kartýnda tanýmlý mý kontrolü *************

					If StokKartindaTanimliMi(FasonGelen_StokKoduVal, "", ZUS00) Then
						FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.ACIKLAMA = "FASON ÇIKIÞ FÝÞÝ YOK - STOK00 - ( " & Trim(FasonGelen_StokKoduVal) & " )"
						FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_LAZERKESIMNO = "STOK KARTINDAN"
	
						If ZUS00.GetRecCount > 0 Then
							For x = 1 To ZUS00.GetRecCount 	
	
								If x > 1 Then
									SatirNo = FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.AddRow
									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.SetCurrentRow SatirNo

									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_KOD = FasonGelen_StokKoduVal
									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_AD = FasonGelen_StokAdiVal
									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_SF_MIKTAR = FasonGelen_MiktarVal
									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_BIRIM = FasonGelen_StokBirimiVal
									FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO = FasonGelen_LazerKesimNo
								End If
								
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_KOD = ZUS00.HMSTKKOD(x)
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_AD = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", ZUS00.HMSTKKOD(x), "")
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "IUNIT", ZUS00.HMSTKKOD(x), "")
				
								SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray = Doc.SonSatinalma(ZUS00.HMSTKKOD(x), TarihVal)
						
								If IsArray(SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray) Then
									SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati = SonSatinAlmaFiyatArray(2)
								End If
				
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_FIYAT = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_REFTARIH = TarihVal
	
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_BIRIM_MIKTAR = ZUS00.MIKTAR(x)
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TOPLAM_MIKTAR = ZUS00.MIKTAR(x) * FasonGelen_MiktarVal

								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR = SonSatinalmaBirim_Birim_TL_Fiyati * ZUS00.MIKTAR(x) * FasonGelen_MiktarVal
								FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.FASONGELEN_TL_BIRIMMALIYET = Doc.Div(FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_TL_TUTAR, FasonGelen_MiktarVal) 

							Next
						End If
	
					Else
						FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.ACIKLAMA = "TANIMSIZ"
						FRMSTACKMAKROTABLET.TUKETILEN_LAZERKESIMNO = "TANIMSIZ"

						TanimsizUyariVer = True
					End If
				End If
			End If

			Set S63DB = Nothing

		End If
	Next
	
	'*************************************

	For j = 1 To  S68T.GetRecCount

		S68T.MASRAFPAYIFIYATM(j) = 0

		Set FRMSTACKMAKROTABLETSTACK2 = Doc.Select2G("FRM_STACK_MAKROTABLET_STACK2", "FRM_STACK_MAKROTABLET", "FASONGELEN_KOD = '"& S68T.KOD(j) &"' & FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO = '"& S68T.REFTEXT02(j)  &"' ", "", "FASONGELEN_KOD+FASONGELEN_LAZERKESIMNO", -1)
	
		If FRMSTACKMAKROTABLETSTACK2.GetRecCount > 0 Then

			BirimUrunTLMaliyet = FRMSTACKMAKROTABLETSTACK2.FASONGELEN_TL_BIRIMMALIYET(1)
			
			S68T.MASRAFPAYIFIYATM(j) = BirimUrunTLMaliyet
			S68T.MASRAFPAYITUTARM(j) = BirimUrunTLMaliyet * S68T.SF_MIKTAR(j)
		End If

		Set FRMSTACKMAKROTABLETSTACK2 = Nothing
	Next

	If TanimsizUyariVer Then
		msgbox "[Daðýtýlacak Maliyetler] Sekmesindeki " & vbcrlf & "Sac Tüketim Maliyet Tablosunda Tanýmsýz Satýr/lar Var. Kontrol Ediniz."
	End If
End Sub

Makro Kodu Sekmesi : 

Sub cmd_oncalisma_geriyukle
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")
	Set T40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
	Set T40E = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40E")

	T40T.Empty

	For i = 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount
		SatirNo = T40T.AddRow
		T40T.SetCurrentRow SatirNo

		T40T.REFTEXT08= ZUT40T.REFTEXT08(i)
		T40T.REFTEXT09 = ZUT40T.REFTEXT09(i)
		T40T.KOD = ZUT40T.KOD(i)
		T40T.SF_MIKTAR = ZUT40T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_1 = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_1(i) 
		'T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2 = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2(i) 
		T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_REF_2 = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_REF_2(i) 
		T40T.OR_FIYAT = ZUT40T.OR_FIYAT(i) 
		'T40T.OR_TUTAR = ZUT40T.OR_TUTAR(i) 
		T40T.PRICEUNIT = ZUT40T.PRICEUNIT(i) 
		T40T.KUR = ZUT40T.KUR(i) 
		'T40T.RTESTARIH = ZUT40T.RTESTARIH(i) 
		T40T.REV_RTESTARIH = ZUT40T.REV_RTESTARIH(i) 
		'T40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR = ZUT40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(i) 
		'T40T.OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR = ZUT40T.OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR(i) 
		T40T.KDV_ORANI = ZUT40T.KDV_ORANI(i) 
		T40T.VERARTTIPI_1 = ZUT40T.VERARTTIPI_1(i) 
		T40T.YVERART_1 = ZUT40T.YVERART_1(i) 

		T40T.SGK_1 = ZUT40T.SGK_1(i)
		T40T.SGK_2 = ZUT40T.SGK_2(i)
		T40T.SGK_3 = ZUT40T.SGK_3(i)
		T40T.SGK_4 = ZUT40T.SGK_4(i)

		For n = 1 To 4
			T40T.SetFieldValue "ISKONTOTIPI_" & n, SatirNo,  ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("ISKONTOTIPI_" & n, i)
			T40T.SetFieldValue "YISKONTO_" & n, SatirNo, ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("YISKONTO_" & n, i)
			T40T.SetFieldValue "OR_TISKONTO_" & n, SatirNo, ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("OR_TISKONTO_" & n, i)
		Next

		T40T.TAHVALORTARIH = ZUT40T.TAHVALORTARIH(i) 
		T40T.REV_TAHVALORTARIH = ZUT40T.REV_TAHVALORTARIH(i) 

	Next

	T40T.Sort("REFTEXT09")
	T40T.SetCurrentRow 1

	ZUT40T.Empty

	T40E.REFTEXT05 = ""
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub cmd_MamulKodu_Cevir
	UrunTanimsizlar = ""
	Set T40E = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40E")
	Set T40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")

	Call cmd_OnCalismayi_Kopyala

	T40T.SafePack

	For i = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
		T40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If Left(Trim(T40T.KOD(i)), 1) = "7" Then
			If Trim(T40T.URUNSTKKODU(i)) <> "" Then
				KarsiKod = T40T.KOD(i)
				T40T.KOD(i) = Trim(T40T.URUNSTKKODU(i))

				T40T.URUNSTKKODU(i) = KarsiKod 
				T40T.URUNSTKADI(i) = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00", "AD", KarsiKod, -1)
			Else
				T40T.KOD(i) = ""
				T40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i) = ""
				T40T.SetFieldValueNV "SF_MIKTAR", i, 0
				T40T.REV_RTESTARIH(i) = ""
				T40T.RTESTARIH(i) = ""
			End If
		Else
			If Left(Trim(T40T.KOD(i)), 1) <> "5"  Then
				T40T.KOD(i) = ""
				T40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i) = ""
				T40T.SetFieldValueNV "SF_MIKTAR", i, 0
				T40T.REV_RTESTARIH(i) = ""
				T40T.RTESTARIH(i) = ""
			End If
		End If
	Next

	T40T.SetCurrentRow 1

	T40T.SafePack

	For i = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
		T40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If Left(Trim(T40T.KOD(i)), 2) = "40" Then

			For j = 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount

				If T40T.REFTEXT09(i) = ZUT40T.REFTEXT09(j) Then

					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2(j) 
	
					T40T.SetFieldValueNV "OR_FIYAT", i, 0
					T40T.PRICEUNIT(i) = ZUT40T.PRICEUNIT(j) 
					T40T.KUR(i) = ZUT40T.KUR(j) 

					T40T.SetFieldValue "OR_FIYAT", i, ZUT40T.OR_TUTAR(j) 

					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(j) 
					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_11(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_11(j) 
					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_12(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_12(j) 
					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_13(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_13(j) 
					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_14(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_14(j) 

					For n = 1 To 4
						T40T.SetFieldValue "ISKONTOTIPI_" & n, i,  ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("ISKONTOTIPI_" & n, j) 
						T40T.SetFieldValue "YISKONTO_" & n, i, ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("YISKONTO_" & n, j) 
						T40T.SetFieldValue "OR_TISKONTO_" & n, i, ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("OR_TISKONTO_" & n, j) 
					Next

					T40T.TAHVALORTARIH(i) = ZUT40T.TAHVALORTARIH(j) 
					T40T.REV_TAHVALORTARIH(i) = ZUT40T.REV_TAHVALORTARIH(j) 
				End If
			Next
		End If
	Next

	T40T.SafePack

	T40T.Sort("REFTEXT09")
	T40T.SetCurrentRow 1

	T40E.REFTEXT05 = "KOD_DÖNÜÞTÜRME_YAPILMIÞ"
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------
Sub cmd_OnCalismayi_Kopyala
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")
	Set T40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
	Set T40E = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40E")
	Set T40I = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40I")
	
	T40T.SafePack

	'************** eðer kod dönüþtürme yapýlmamýþ ise ana tablodaki çalýþmayý tümüyle ön çalýþma tablosuna aktarmasý için ön çalýþma tablosunu siler
	If Trim(T40E.REFTEXT05) <> "KOD_DÖNÜÞTÜRME_YAPILMIÞ" Then
		Call oncalisma_sil("cmd_OnCalismayi_Kopyala")
	End If
	'**********************************************

	Toplam = 0	
	IskontoTutari = 0	
	IskontoluTutar = 0
	KdvDahilTutar = 0

	Toplam_GH = 0
	IskontoTutari_GH = 0
	IskontoluTutar_GH = 0
	KdvDahilTutar_GH = 0

	YediliKodSayisi = 0
	UruneEklenecek_Feature_Fiyati = 0

	Set T40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")    
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")   
	
	'Alanlar = ZUT40T.GetFieldNames("")
	
	Alanlar = Array("KOD", "MUSTERIKODU", "PRICEUNIT", "KUR", "TARIH", "NOTES", "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_1", "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15", "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_16", "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2", "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_3", "ARTIKEL_REF_REF_2", _
		"HESAPLANAN_MARJ", "ISKONTO_EFEKTIF", "KDV_ORANI", "OR_FIYAT", "OR_FIYAT_TO_TEKLIF", "OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR", "OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR", "OR_KDVDAHILTUTAR", "OR_KDVTUT_EFEKTIF", "OR_TUTAR", "OR_XISKONTO_TUTARI", "OR_X_KDVTUT", "OR_X_KDVTUT_US", _
		"ISKONTOTIPI_1", "ISKONTOTIPI_2", "ISKONTOTIPI_3", "ISKONTOTIPI_4", "YISKONTO_1", "YISKONTO_2", "YISKONTO_3", "YISKONTO_4", _
		"OR_TISKONTO_1",  "OR_TISKONTO_2",  "OR_TISKONTO_3",  "OR_TISKONTO_4",  _
		"VERARTTIPI_1", "YVERART_1", "OR_TVERART_1", _
		"ODEMEGUNU", "OLUSTURAN", "TEKLIF_FIYAT_PB", "TEKLIF_PB_KUR", "ODEMESEKLI", "CHPROJENO", "CHSIPNO", "CHSIPANO", "CHTEKLIFTALEBINO", "FOKOD", _
		"SF_IMIKTAR", "SF_KABULEDILENMIKTAR", "SF_MIKTAR", "SF_NETKAPANANMIK", "SF_ODONEMKAPANANMIK", "SF_PMIKTAR", _
		"REV_RTESTARIH", "RTESTARIH", "REV_TAHVALORTARIH", "TAHVALORTARIH", "RKAPANISTARIH", "REFTEXT09", "REFTEXT01", "REFTEXT08", "ONAY", "GK_1", "SGK_3", "SGK_4", "SGK_2", "GK_3")

	ZU_GirisVar = False

refnum=0

	For i = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
		T40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15(i) <> 1 Then
			If Left(T40T.KOD(i), 1) <> "4" Then
refnum=refnum+1
				ZU_GirisVar = True

				SatirNo = ZUT40T.AddRow
				ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow SatirNo

				For Each Alan in Alanlar
					AlanDegeri = T40T.GetFieldValue(Alan, i)

					If Alan = "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15" Then
						AlanDegeri = 1

					ElseIf Alan = "KOD" Then
						UrunStkKoduVal = T40T.GetFieldValue("URUNSTKKODU", i)
						UrunStkAdiVal = T40T.GetFieldValue("URUNSTKADI", i)
						ZUT40T.SetFieldValue "URUNSTKKODU", SatirNo, UrunStkKoduVal
						ZUT40T.SetFieldValue "URUNSTKADI",SatirNo, UrunStkAdiVal

						If Trim(UrunStkKoduVal) <> "" Then
							YediliKodSayisi = YediliKodSayisi + 1
						End If

					ElseIf Alan = "OR_TUTAR" Then
						If Left(ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("KOD", SatirNo), 1) <> "5" Then
							Toplam = AlanDegeri + Toplam
						End If

						Toplam_GH = AlanDegeri + Toplam_GH

					ElseIf Alan = "OR_XISKONTO_TUTARI" Then
						If Left(ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("KOD", SatirNo), 1) <> "5" Then
							IskontoTutari = AlanDegeri + IskontoTutari
						End If

						IskontoTutari_GH = AlanDegeri + IskontoTutari_GH

					ElseIf Alan = "OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR" Then
						If Left(ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("KOD", SatirNo), 1) <> "5" Then
							IskontoluTutar = AlanDegeri + IskontoluTutar
						End If

						IskontoluTutar_GH = AlanDegeri + IskontoluTutar_GH

					ElseIf Alan = "OR_KDVDAHILTUTAR" Then
						If Left(ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("KOD", SatirNo), 1) <> "5" Then
							KdvDahilTutar = AlanDegeri + KdvDahilTutar
						End If

						KdvDahilTutar_GH = AlanDegeri + KdvDahilTutar_GH
					End If
		
					ZUT40T.SetFieldValue Alan, SatirNo, AlanDegeri
				Next

				T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15(i) = 1
			End If
			
		Else
			'Aktarýlan satýrý güncelleme
			For j = 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount
				ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow j

				If ZUT40T.KOD(j) = T40T.KOD(i) Then

					ZU_GirisVar = True

					For Each Alan in Alanlar
						AlanDegeri = T40T.GetFieldValue(Alan, i)

						If Alan = "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15" Then
							AlanDegeri = 1

						ElseIf Alan = "KOD" Then
							UrunStkKoduVal = T40T.GetFieldValue("URUNSTKKODU", i)
							UrunStkAdiVal = T40T.GetFieldValue("URUNSTKADI", i)
							ZUT40T.SetFieldValue "URUNSTKKODU", j, UrunStkKoduVal
							ZUT40T.SetFieldValue "URUNSTKADI", j, UrunStkAdiVal

							If Trim(UrunStkKoduVal) <> "" Then
								YediliKodSayisi = YediliKodSayisi + 1
							End If

							If Trim(AlanDegeri) = "" Then
								ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15(j) = 0
								ZUT40T.PRICEUNIT(j)= ""
								ZUT40T.KUR(j) = 0
							End If

						ElseIf Alan = "OR_TUTAR" Then
							If Left(ZUT40T.KOD(j), 1) <> "5" Then
								Toplam = AlanDegeri + Toplam
							End If
	
							Toplam_GH = AlanDegeri + Toplam_GH
	
						ElseIf Alan = "OR_XISKONTO_TUTARI" Then
							If Left(ZUT40T.KOD(j), 1) <> "5" Then
								IskontoTutari = AlanDegeri + IskontoTutari
							End If
	
							IskontoTutari_GH = AlanDegeri + IskontoTutari_GH
	
						ElseIf Alan = "OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR" Then
							If Left(ZUT40T.KOD(j), 1) <> "5" Then
								IskontoluTutar = AlanDegeri + IskontoluTutar
							End If
	
							IskontoluTutar_GH = AlanDegeri + IskontoluTutar_GH
	
						ElseIf Alan = "OR_KDVDAHILTUTAR" Then
							If Left(ZUT40T.KOD(j), 1) <> "5" Then
								KdvDahilTutar = AlanDegeri + KdvDahilTutar
							End If
	
							KdvDahilTutar_GH = AlanDegeri + KdvDahilTutar_GH

						End If

						If Alan = "REFTEXT09" Then
							If ZUT40T.GetRecCount >= T40T.GetRecCount Then
								If Trim(ZUT40T.REFTEXT09(j)) = "" Then
									ZUT40T.SetFieldValue Alan, j, Right("00" & ZUT40T.SRNUM(j), 2)
								End If
							Else
								ZUT40T.SetFieldValue Alan, j, AlanDegeri
							End If
						Else
							ZUT40T.SetFieldValue Alan, j, AlanDegeri
						End If
					Next
				End If
			Next
		End If

		'************* KTA ALANLARINI DA AKTAR ***********************
		'If ZU_GirisVar Then
			'Doc.UFLD00_CreateEditTable "XXXulfd","ZU_TEKL40T", T40E.EVRAKNO & ZUT40T.TRNUM(i)
		'	Doc.UFLD00_CreateEditTable "XXXulfd","ZU_TEKL40T", T40E.EVRAKNO & ZUT40T.TRNUM(refnum)
		'	Set KTAYAZ = Doc.GetTableObject("XXXulfd")   
	
		'	EvrakNoTrnumVal = T40E.EVRAKNO & T40T.TRNUM(i)
	
		'	KTAYAZ.ACIKLAMA1 = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "ACIKLAMA1", 0)) 
		'	KTAYAZ.ACIKLAMA2 = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "ACIKLAMA2", 0)) 
		'	KTAYAZ.ACIKLAMA3 = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "ACIKLAMA3", 0)) 
		'	KTAYAZ.ACIKLAMA4 = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "ACIKLAMA4", 0)) 
		'	KTAYAZ.ACIKLAMA5 = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "ACIKLAMA5", 0)) 
		'	KTAYAZ.PRO = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "PRO", 0)) 
		'	KTAYAZ.RBLK = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "RBLK", 0)) 
	
		'	KTAYAZ.Exec "SAVE" 	
		'	Set KTAYAZ = Nothing
		'End If
	Next

	ZUT40T.Sort("<REFTEXT09")

	For i = 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount
		ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If Trim(ZUT40T.URUNSTKKODU(i)) <> "" Then
			ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(i) = Doc.Div(T40I.SumOf("TEKLIF_TUTAR"), YediliKodSayisi) 'incoterms
		Else
			ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(i) = 0
		End If
	Next

	For i = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
		T40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If Trim(T40T.URUNSTKKODU(i)) <> "" Then
			T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(i) = Doc.Div(T40I.SumOf("TEKLIF_TUTAR"), YediliKodSayisi) 'incoterms
		Else
			T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(i) = 0
		End If
	Next

	'********************* önçalýþma satý sýralama ****************************
	For i= 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount
		ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If Trim(ZUT40T.KOD(i))<>"" Then
			If Trim(ZUT40T.REFTEXT09(i)) = "" Then ZUT40T.REFTEXT09(i) = Right("00" & ZUT40T.SRNUM(i), 2)
		End If
	Next

	ZUT40T.SafePack
	ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow 1
	ZUT40T.Sort("REFTEXT09")
	'**************************************************************

	T40E.REFNUM_GH1 = Toplam_GH
	T40E.REFNUM_GH2 = Doc.Div(IskontoTutari_GH, Toplam_GH)  * 100    'iskonto    'TEKL40E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI
	T40E.REFNUM_GH3 = IskontoTutari_GH
	T40E.REFNUM_GH4 = IskontoluTutar_GH  
	T40E.REFNUM_GH5 = KdvDahilTutar_GH  

	T40E.REFNUM_MH1 = Toplam
	T40E.REFNUM_MH2 = Doc.Div(IskontoTutari, Toplam)  * 100 
	T40E.REFNUM_MH3 = IskontoTutari
	T40E.REFNUM_MH4 = IskontoluTutar  
	T40E.REFNUM_MH5 = KdvDahilTutar

	Set ZUT40TStack = Doc.Select2G("fsffff", "ZU_TEKL40T", "REFTEXT08<>'' ", "", "REFTEXT08+KOD", -1)
	If ZUT40TStack.GetRecCount > 0 Then
		For i = 1To ZUT40TStack.GetRecCount
			If Left(ZUT40TStack.KOD(i), 1) = "7" Then
				Set ZUT40TStack2 = Doc.Select2G("fs22ffff", "ZU_TEKL40T", "KOD<> '"& ZUT40TStack.KOD(i) &"' & REFTEXT08='"& ZUT40TStack.REFTEXT08(i)&"' ", "", "REFTEXT08", -1)
				If ZUT40TStack2.GetRecCount > 0 Then
					UruneEklenecek_Feature_Fiyati = ZUT40TStack2.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(1)
				
					For j = 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount
						ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow j

						If ZUT40T.KOD(j) = ZUT40TStack.KOD(i) Then
							ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_11(j) = UruneEklenecek_Feature_Fiyati 'Ayný feature gruplular için fiyat
						End If
					Next
				End If
				Set ZUT40TStack2 = Nothing
			End If
		Next	
	End If

	Set ZUT40TStack = Nothing

	Set T40TStack = Doc.Select2G("fsffuuuff", "TEKL40T", "REFTEXT08<>'' ", "", "REFTEXT08+KOD", -1)
	If T40TStack.GetRecCount > 0 Then
		For i = 1 To T40TStack.GetRecCount
			If Left(T40TStack.KOD(i), 1) = "7" Then
				Set T40TStack2 = Doc.Select2G("fs2gg2ffff", "TEKL40T", "KOD<> '"&T40TStack.KOD(i) &"' & REFTEXT08='"& T40TStack.REFTEXT08(i)&"' ", "", "REFTEXT08", -1)
				If T40TStack2.GetRecCount > 0 Then
					UruneEklenecek_Feature_Fiyati = T40TStack2.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(1)
				
					For j = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
						T40T.SetCurrentRow j

						If T40T.KOD(j) = T40TStack.KOD(i) Then
							T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_11(j) = UruneEklenecek_Feature_Fiyati 'Ayný feature gruplular için fiyat
						End If
					Next
				End If
				Set T40TStack2 = Nothing
			End If
		Next	
	End If

	Set T40TStack = Nothing
End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------
Sub oncalisma_sil(Nereden)
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")
	ZUT40T.SafePack

	If Trim(ZUT40T.KOD) = "" Then
		If Nereden <> "cmd_OnCalismayi_Kopyala" Then
			msgbox "Tablo Boþ."
		End If

		Exit Sub
	End If

	If Nereden <> "cmd_OnCalismayi_Kopyala" Then
		RetCode=Doc.d7MsgBox("Tablodaki Bilgiler Silinecek, emin misiniz?","Uyarý",MB_YESNO)
	
		If RetCode<>vbYes Then
			Exit Sub
		End If
	End If

	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")
	ZUT40T.Empty

	Set T40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")

	For i = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
		T40T.SetCurrentRow i

		T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15(i) = 0
	Next

	T40T.SetCurrentRow 1

	Set T40E = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40E")

	T40E.REFNUM_GH1 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_GH2 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_GH3 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_GH4 = 0  
	T40E.REFNUM_GH5 = 0  

	T40E.REFNUM_MH1 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_MH2 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_MH3 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_MH4 = 0  
	T40E.REFNUM_MH5 = 0

	T40E.REFTEXT05 = ""
End Sub
'--------------------------------------
Sub cmd_oncalisma_sil
	Call oncalisma_sil("cmd_oncalisma_sil")
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MsgBoxToTxt(Mesaj)
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	tmpFolder = fso.GetSpecialFolder(2)
	dosyaAdi = tmpFolder & "\Hata.txt"
	Set HataFile = Fso.OpenTextFile(dosyaAdi, 2, True)
	HataFile.WriteLine(Mesaj)
	HataFile.Close
	Set wshShell = CreateObject("WSCript.shell")
	wshshell.run "notepad " & dosyaAdi, 1, True
	set wshshell = nothing
End Sub

	Doc.RunMacro0 "MAKR7S.TEKL40","Makro1"
End Sub

			COMBOBOX D=ESL_ORTVALORTARIH HIDDEN=1
			EDITTEXT D=ESL_VALOR_FARKI HIDDEN=1
			EDITTEXT D=ACK_CH_TUTAR HIDDEN=1 NOEDIT=1
			COMBOBOX D=ACK_ORTVALORTARIH HIDDEN=1 NOEDIT=1
			EDITTEXT D=ACK_VALOR_FARKI HIDDEN=1 NOEDIT=1
				EDITTEXT D=REFNUM01 SIGNEDVALUE=1

	ENDTAB

Sub cmd_oncalisma_geriyukle
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")
	Set T40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")

	T40T.Empty

	For i = 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount
		SatirNo = T40T.AddRow
		T40T.SetCurrentRow SatirNo

		T40T.REFTEXT08= ZUT40T.REFTEXT08(i)
		T40T.REFTEXT09 = ZUT40T.REFTEXT09(i)
		T40T.KOD = ZUT40T.KOD(i)
		T40T.SF_MIKTAR = ZUT40T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_1 = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_1(i) 
		'T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2 = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2(i) 
		T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_REF_2 = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_REF_2(i) 
		T40T.OR_FIYAT = ZUT40T.OR_FIYAT(i) 
		'T40T.OR_TUTAR = ZUT40T.OR_TUTAR(i) 
		T40T.PRICEUNIT = ZUT40T.PRICEUNIT(i) 
		T40T.KUR = ZUT40T.KUR(i) 
		'T40T.RTESTARIH = ZUT40T.RTESTARIH(i) 
		T40T.REV_RTESTARIH = ZUT40T.REV_RTESTARIH(i) 
		'T40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR = ZUT40T.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(i) 
		'T40T.OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR = ZUT40T.OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR(i) 
		T40T.KDV_ORANI = ZUT40T.KDV_ORANI(i) 
		T40T.VERARTTIPI_1 = ZUT40T.VERARTTIPI_1(i) 
		T40T.YVERART_1 = ZUT40T.YVERART_1(i) 

		T40T.SGK_1 = ZUT40T.SGK_1(i)
		T40T.SGK_2 = ZUT40T.SGK_2(i)
		T40T.SGK_3 = ZUT40T.SGK_3(i)
		T40T.SGK_4 = ZUT40T.SGK_4(i)

		For n = 1 To 4
			T40T.SetFieldValue "ISKONTOTIPI_" & n, SatirNo,  ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("ISKONTOTIPI_" & n, i)
			T40T.SetFieldValue "YISKONTO_" & n, SatirNo, ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("YISKONTO_" & n, i)
			T40T.SetFieldValue "OR_TISKONTO_" & n, SatirNo, ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("OR_TISKONTO_" & n, i)
		Next

		T40T.TAHVALORTARIH = ZUT40T.TAHVALORTARIH(i) 
		T40T.REV_TAHVALORTARIH = ZUT40T.REV_TAHVALORTARIH(i) 

	Next

	T40T.Sort("REFTEXT09")
	T40T.SetCurrentRow 1

	ZUT40T.Empty
End Sub

Sub cmd_MamulKodu_Cevir
	UrunTanimsizlar = ""
	Set T40E = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40E")
	Set T40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")

	Call cmd_OnCalismayi_Kopyala

	T40T.SafePack

	For i = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
		T40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If Left(Trim(T40T.KOD(i)), 1) = "7" Then
			If Trim(T40T.URUNSTKKODU(i)) <> "" Then
				KarsiKod = T40T.KOD(i)
				T40T.KOD(i) = Trim(T40T.URUNSTKKODU(i))

				T40T.URUNSTKKODU(i) = KarsiKod 
				T40T.URUNSTKADI(i) = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00", "AD", KarsiKod, -1)
			Else
				T40T.KOD(i) = ""
				T40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i) = ""
				T40T.SetFieldValueNV "SF_MIKTAR", i, 0
				T40T.REV_RTESTARIH(i) = ""
				T40T.RTESTARIH(i) = ""
			End If
		Else
			If Left(Trim(T40T.KOD(i)), 1) <> "5"  Then
				T40T.KOD(i) = ""
				T40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i) = ""
				T40T.SetFieldValueNV "SF_MIKTAR", i, 0
				T40T.REV_RTESTARIH(i) = ""
				T40T.RTESTARIH(i) = ""
			End If
		End If
	Next

	T40T.SetCurrentRow 1

	T40T.SafePack

	For i = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
		T40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If Left(Trim(T40T.KOD(i)), 2) = "40" Then

			For j = 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount

				If T40T.REFTEXT09(i) = ZUT40T.REFTEXT09(j) Then

					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2(j) 
	
					T40T.SetFieldValueNV "OR_FIYAT", i, 0
					T40T.PRICEUNIT(i) = ZUT40T.PRICEUNIT(j) 
					T40T.KUR(i) = ZUT40T.KUR(j) 

					T40T.SetFieldValue "OR_FIYAT", i, ZUT40T.OR_TUTAR(j) 

					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(j) 
					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_11(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_11(j) 
					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_12(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_12(j) 
					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_13(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_13(j) 
					T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_14(i) = ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_14(j) 

					For n = 1 To 4
						T40T.SetFieldValue "ISKONTOTIPI_" & n, i,  ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("ISKONTOTIPI_" & n, j) 
						T40T.SetFieldValue "YISKONTO_" & n, i, ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("YISKONTO_" & n, j) 
						T40T.SetFieldValue "OR_TISKONTO_" & n, i, ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("OR_TISKONTO_" & n, j) 
					Next

					T40T.TAHVALORTARIH(i) = ZUT40T.TAHVALORTARIH(j) 
					T40T.REV_TAHVALORTARIH(i) = ZUT40T.REV_TAHVALORTARIH(j) 
				End If
			Next
		End If
	Next

	T40T.SafePack

	T40T.Sort("REFTEXT09")
	T40T.SetCurrentRow 1
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------
Sub cmd_OnCalismayi_Kopyala
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")
	Set T40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
	Set T40E = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40E")
	Set T40I = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40I")
	
	T40T.SafePack

	Toplam = 0	
	IskontoTutari = 0	
	IskontoluTutar = 0
	KdvDahilTutar = 0

	Toplam_GH = 0
	IskontoTutari_GH = 0
	IskontoluTutar_GH = 0
	KdvDahilTutar_GH = 0

	YediliKodSayisi = 0
	UruneEklenecek_Feature_Fiyati = 0

	Set T40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")    
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")   
	
	'Alanlar = ZUT40T.GetFieldNames("")
	
	Alanlar = Array("KOD", "MUSTERIKODU", "PRICEUNIT", "KUR", "TARIH", "NOTES", "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_1", "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15", "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_16", "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2", "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_3", "ARTIKEL_REF_REF_2", _
		"HESAPLANAN_MARJ", "ISKONTO_EFEKTIF", "KDV_ORANI", "OR_FIYAT", "OR_FIYAT_TO_TEKLIF", "OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR", "OR_IVD_KH_TUTAR", "OR_KDVDAHILTUTAR", "OR_KDVTUT_EFEKTIF", "OR_TUTAR", "OR_XISKONTO_TUTARI", "OR_X_KDVTUT", "OR_X_KDVTUT_US", _
		"ISKONTOTIPI_1", "ISKONTOTIPI_2", "ISKONTOTIPI_3", "ISKONTOTIPI_4", "YISKONTO_1", "YISKONTO_2", "YISKONTO_3", "YISKONTO_4", _
		"OR_TISKONTO_1",  "OR_TISKONTO_2",  "OR_TISKONTO_3",  "OR_TISKONTO_4",  _
		"VERARTTIPI_1", "YVERART_1", "OR_TVERART_1", _
		"ODEMEGUNU", "OLUSTURAN", "TEKLIF_FIYAT_PB", "TEKLIF_PB_KUR", "ODEMESEKLI", "CHPROJENO", "CHSIPNO", "CHSIPANO", "CHTEKLIFTALEBINO", "FOKOD", _
		"SF_IMIKTAR", "SF_KABULEDILENMIKTAR", "SF_MIKTAR", "SF_NETKAPANANMIK", "SF_ODONEMKAPANANMIK", "SF_PMIKTAR", _
		"REV_RTESTARIH", "RTESTARIH", "REV_TAHVALORTARIH", "TAHVALORTARIH", "RKAPANISTARIH", "REFTEXT09", "REFTEXT01", "REFTEXT08", "ONAY", "GK_1", "SGK_3", "SGK_4", "SGK_2", "GK_3")

	For i = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
		T40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15(i) <> 1 Then
			If Left(T40T.KOD(i), 1) <> "4" Then

				SatirNo = ZUT40T.AddRow
				ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow SatirNo

				For Each Alan in Alanlar
					AlanDegeri = T40T.GetFieldValue(Alan, i)

					If Alan = "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15" Then
						AlanDegeri = 1

					ElseIf Alan = "KOD" Then
						UrunStkKoduVal = T40T.GetFieldValue("URUNSTKKODU", i)
						UrunStkAdiVal = T40T.GetFieldValue("URUNSTKADI", i)
						ZUT40T.SetFieldValue "URUNSTKKODU", SatirNo, UrunStkKoduVal
						ZUT40T.SetFieldValue "URUNSTKADI", SatirNo, UrunStkAdiVal

						If Trim(UrunStkKoduVal) <> "" Then
							YediliKodSayisi = YediliKodSayisi + 1
						End If

					ElseIf Alan = "OR_TUTAR" Then
						If Left(ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("KOD", SatirNo), 1) <> "5" Then
							Toplam = AlanDegeri + Toplam
						End If

						Toplam_GH = AlanDegeri + Toplam_GH

					ElseIf Alan = "OR_XISKONTO_TUTARI" Then
						If Left(ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("KOD", SatirNo), 1) <> "5" Then
							IskontoTutari = AlanDegeri + IskontoTutari
						End If

						IskontoTutari_GH = AlanDegeri + IskontoTutari_GH

					ElseIf Alan = "OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR" Then
						If Left(ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("KOD", SatirNo), 1) <> "5" Then
							IskontoluTutar = AlanDegeri + IskontoluTutar
						End If

						IskontoluTutar_GH = AlanDegeri + IskontoluTutar_GH

					ElseIf Alan = "OR_KDVDAHILTUTAR" Then
						If Left(ZUT40T.GetFieldValue("KOD", SatirNo), 1) <> "5" Then
							KdvDahilTutar = AlanDegeri + KdvDahilTutar
						End If

						KdvDahilTutar_GH = AlanDegeri + KdvDahilTutar_GH
					End If
		
					ZUT40T.SetFieldValue Alan, SatirNo, AlanDegeri
				Next

			End If
			
			T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15(i) = 1
		Else
			'Aktarýlan satýrý güncelleme
			For j = 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount
				ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow j

				If ZUT40T.KOD(j) = T40T.KOD(i) Then
					For Each Alan in Alanlar
						AlanDegeri = T40T.GetFieldValue(Alan, i)

						If Alan = "ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15" Then
							AlanDegeri = 1

						ElseIf Alan = "KOD" Then
							UrunStkKoduVal = T40T.GetFieldValue("URUNSTKKODU", i)
							UrunStkAdiVal = T40T.GetFieldValue("URUNSTKADI", i)
							ZUT40T.SetFieldValue "URUNSTKKODU", j, UrunStkKoduVal
							ZUT40T.SetFieldValue "URUNSTKADI", j, UrunStkAdiVal

							If Trim(UrunStkKoduVal) <> "" Then
								YediliKodSayisi = YediliKodSayisi + 1
							End If

							If Trim(AlanDegeri) = "" Then
								ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15(j) = 0
								ZUT40T.PRICEUNIT(j) = ""
								ZUT40T.KUR(j) = 0
							End If

						ElseIf Alan = "OR_TUTAR" Then
							If Left(ZUT40T.KOD(j), 1) <> "5" Then
								Toplam = AlanDegeri + Toplam
							End If
	
							Toplam_GH = AlanDegeri + Toplam_GH
	
						ElseIf Alan = "OR_XISKONTO_TUTARI" Then
							If Left(ZUT40T.KOD(j), 1) <> "5" Then
								IskontoTutari = AlanDegeri + IskontoTutari
							End If
	
							IskontoTutari_GH = AlanDegeri + IskontoTutari_GH
	
						ElseIf Alan = "OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR" Then
							If Left(ZUT40T.KOD(j), 1)<> "5" Then
								IskontoluTutar = AlanDegeri + IskontoluTutar
							End If
	
							IskontoluTutar_GH = AlanDegeri + IskontoluTutar_GH
	
						ElseIf Alan = "OR_KDVDAHILTUTAR" Then
							If Left(ZUT40T.KOD(j), 1) <> "5" Then
								KdvDahilTutar = AlanDegeri + KdvDahilTutar
							End If
	
							KdvDahilTutar_GH = AlanDegeri + KdvDahilTutar_GH

						End If

						If Alan = "REFTEXT09" Then
							If ZUT40T.GetRecCount >= T40T.GetRecCount Then
								If Trim(ZUT40T.REFTEXT09(j)) = "" Then
									ZUT40T.SetFieldValue Alan, j, Right("00" & ZUT40T.SRNUM(j), 2)
								End If
							Else
								ZUT40T.SetFieldValue Alan, j, AlanDegeri
							End If
						Else
							ZUT40T.SetFieldValue Alan, j, AlanDegeri
						End If
					Next
				End If
			Next
		End If

		'************* KTA ALANLARINI DA AKTAR ***********************

		Doc.UFLD00_CreateEditTable "XXXulfd","ZU_TEKL40T", ZUT40T.EVRAKNO(i) & ZUT40T.TRNUM(i)
		Set KTAYAZ = Doc.GetTableObject("XXXulfd")   

		EvrakNoTrnumVal = T40T.EVRAKNO(i) & T40T.TRNUM(i)

		KTAYAZ.ACIKLAMA1 = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "ACIKLAMA1", 0)) 
		KTAYAZ.ACIKLAMA2 = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "ACIKLAMA2", 0)) 
		KTAYAZ.ACIKLAMA3 = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "ACIKLAMA3", 0)) 
		KTAYAZ.ACIKLAMA4 = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "ACIKLAMA4", 0)) 
		KTAYAZ.ACIKLAMA5 = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "ACIKLAMA5", 0)) 
		KTAYAZ.PRO = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "PRO", 0)) 
		KTAYAZ.RBLK = Trim(Doc.GetUDFValue("TEKL40T", EvrakNoTrnumVal, "RBLK", 0)) 

		KTAYAZ.Exec "SAVE" 	
		Set KTAYAZ = Nothing
	Next

	ZUT40T.Sort("<REFTEXT09")

	For i = 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount
		ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If Trim(ZUT40T.URUNSTKKODU(i)) <> "" Then
			ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(i) = Doc.Div(T40I.SumOf("TEKLIF_TUTAR"), YediliKodSayisi) 'incoterms
		Else
			ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(i) = 0
		End If
	Next

	For i = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
		T40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If Trim(T40T.URUNSTKKODU(i)) <> "" Then
			T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(i) = Doc.Div(T40I.SumOf("TEKLIF_TUTAR"), YediliKodSayisi) 'incoterms
		Else
			T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_10(i) = 0
		End If
	Next

	'********************* ön çalýþma satý sýralama ****************************
	For i= 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount
		ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow i

		If Trim(ZUT40T.KOD(i))<>"" Then
			If Trim(ZUT40T.REFTEXT09(i)) = "" Then ZUT40T.REFTEXT09(i) = Right("00" & ZUT40T.SRNUM(i), 2)
		End If
	Next

	ZUT40T.SafePack
	ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow 1
	ZUT40T.Sort("REFTEXT09")
	'**************************************************************

	T40E.REFNUM_GH1 = Toplam_GH
	T40E.REFNUM_GH2 = Doc.Div(IskontoTutari_GH, Toplam_GH)  * 100    'iskonto    'TEKL40E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI
	T40E.REFNUM_GH3 = IskontoTutari_GH
	T40E.REFNUM_GH4 = IskontoluTutar_GH  
	T40E.REFNUM_GH5 = KdvDahilTutar_GH  

	T40E.REFNUM_MH1 = Toplam
	T40E.REFNUM_MH2 = Doc.Div(IskontoTutari, Toplam)  * 100 
	T40E.REFNUM_MH3 = IskontoTutari
	T40E.REFNUM_MH4 = IskontoluTutar  
	T40E.REFNUM_MH5 = KdvDahilTutar

	Set ZUT40TStack = Doc.Select2G("fsffff", "ZU_TEKL40T", "REFTEXT08<>'' ", "", "REFTEXT08+KOD", -1)
	If ZUT40TStack.GetRecCount > 0 Then
		For i = 1 To ZUT40TStack.GetRecCount
			If Left(ZUT40TStack.KOD(i), 1) = "7" Then
				Set ZUT40TStack2 = Doc.Select2G("fs22ffff", "ZU_TEKL40T", "KOD<> '"& ZUT40TStack.KOD(i) &"' & REFTEXT08='"& ZUT40TStack.REFTEXT08(i)&"' ", "", "REFTEXT08", -1)
				If ZUT40TStack2.GetRecCount > 0 Then
					UruneEklenecek_Feature_Fiyati = ZUT40TStack2.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(1)
				
					For j = 1 To ZUT40T.GetRecCount
						ZUT40T.SetCurrentRow j

						If ZUT40T.KOD(j) = ZUT40TStack.KOD(i) Then
							ZUT40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_11(j) = UruneEklenecek_Feature_Fiyati 'Ayný feature gruplular için fiyat
						End If
					Next
				End If
				Set ZUT40TStack2 = Nothing
			End If
		Next	
	End If

	Set ZUT40TStack = Nothing

	Set T40TStack = Doc.Select2G("fsffuuuff", "TEKL40T", "REFTEXT08<>'' ", "", "REFTEXT08+KOD", -1)
	If T40TStack.GetRecCount > 0 Then
		For i = 1 To T40TStack.GetRecCount
			If Left(T40TStack.KOD(i), 1) = "7" Then
				Set T40TStack2 = Doc.Select2G("fs2gg2ffff", "TEKL40T", "KOD<> '"& T40TStack.KOD(i) &"' & REFTEXT08='"& T40TStack.REFTEXT08(i)&"' ", "", "REFTEXT08", -1)
				If T40TStack2.GetRecCount > 0 Then
					UruneEklenecek_Feature_Fiyati = T40TStack2.OR_ISKONTOLU_TUTAR(1)
				
					For j = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
						T40T.SetCurrentRow j

						If T40T.KOD(j) = T40TStack.KOD(i) Then
							T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_11(j) = UruneEklenecek_Feature_Fiyati 'Ayný feature gruplular için fiyat
						End If
					Next
				End If
				Set T40TStack2 = Nothing
			End If
		Next	
	End If

	Set T40TStack = Nothing
End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------
Sub cmd_oncalisma_sil
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")
	ZUT40T.SafePack

	If Trim(ZUT40T.KOD) = "" Then
		msgbox "Tablo Boþ."
		
		Exit Sub
	End If

	RetCode=Doc.d7MsgBox("Tablodaki Bilgiler Silinecek, emin misiniz?","Uyarý",MB_YESNO)

	If RetCode<>vbYes Then
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	Set ZUT40T = Doc.GetTableObject("ZU_TEKL40T")
	ZUT40T.Empty

	Set T40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")

	For i = 1 To T40T.GetRecCount
		T40T.SetCurrentRow i

		T40T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_15(i) = 0
	Next

	T40T.SetCurrentRow 1

	Set T40E = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40E")

	T40E.REFNUM_GH1 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_GH2 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_GH3 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_GH4 = 0  
	T40E.REFNUM_GH5 = 0  

	T40E.REFNUM_MH1 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_MH2 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_MH3 = 0
	T40E.REFNUM_MH4 = 0  
	T40E.REFNUM_MH5 = 0
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MsgBoxToTxt(Mesaj)
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	tmpFolder = fso.GetSpecialFolder(2)
	dosyaAdi = tmpFolder & "\Hata.txt"
	Set HataFile = Fso.OpenTextFile(dosyaAdi, 2, True)
	HataFile.WriteLine(Mesaj)
	HataFile.Close
	Set wshShell = CreateObject("WSCript.shell")
	wshshell.run "notepad " & dosyaAdi, 1, True
	set wshshell = nothing
End Sub

End Sub
